field_changes.source:
Free tuner, no ads, no account. Then lessons that listen as you play.

Timbre is a precise tuner and a music teacher in one app. Tune any of 60 instruments in seconds, then play real lessons that listen to you and tell you exactly how you did.

TUNE ANYTHING, FREE
• Every instrument's standard tuning is free, from guitar, ukulele and violin to mandolin, banjo, oud and erhu
• A chromatic and strobe tuner with cent-level precision
• 132 tunings, from drop D and open G to DADGAD, plus your own
• Auto string detection, with a check-off as each string locks in
• Strum to tune: one strum reads every string at once and shows which one to tune first
• Tune by feel: the phone pulses with the beat between your string and its note, slower as they meet and still at the lock, so you can tune without looking
• Studio-lit 3D guitars, basses, violin, cello and mandolin, with the peg to turn shown on the headstock
• Capo, adjustable A4 reference, solfège and sargam note names

LEARN BY PLAYING
• 526 lessons in 11 courses: guitar, ukulele, bass, violin, cello, mandolin, banjo, voice, ear training, music theory and rhythm, plus songbooks for ukulele, mandolin, violin, cello and bass
• Timbre hears every strum: the right chord, on time, and which string didn't ring
• Every note judged as you play it, its pitch to the cent and its timing to the millisecond
• "Show me" plays each new chord on a 3D guitar, the fingers landing in order
• A play-along note highway that slows down for you, then speeds back up as you improve

PLAY SONGS
• 140+ songs, each a full arrangement: classics from Jingle Bells to Amazing Grace, and 50 Originals written for Timbre in today's styles
• Play along with the band in your headphones while the words light up
• Your songs: paste or import any chord chart, transpose it, scroll it in time, and listen to the original on Apple Music beside it

KEEP IT GOING
• Stars, XP, daily quests, streaks and badges
• Apple Watch: a metronome you feel on your wrist, and today's practice at a glance
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, a Live Activity and Siri shortcuts

PRACTICE TOOLS
• Metronome with accents, subdivisions and a speed trainer
• Drone, an intonation trainer, and a chord and scale library
• Ear training: pitch direction, intervals and chord quality, plus a 40-lesson ear course

FREE TO START
Every instrument's standard tuning is free, and guitar, bass, ukulele, violin and cello tune free in every tuning. The first unit of every course and a shelf of songs are free too. Timbre Pro unlocks every lesson and song, every tuning and the full practice set. With notifications on, Timbre reminds you two days before a free trial ends.

Private by design: live microphone audio is analyzed on your device, never recorded or uploaded. No account and no ads.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions.
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://timbre-support.timbre.workers.dev/privacy
field_changes.old:
Accordatore gratis, senza pubblicità né account. Poi lezioni che ti ascoltano suonare.

Timbre unisce un accordatore preciso e un insegnante di musica. Accorda 60 strumenti e scopri esattamente come hai suonato.

ACCORDATURA GRATUITA
• L’accordatura standard di ogni strumento è gratis: chitarra, ukulele, violino, mandolino, banjo, oud, erhu e altri.
• Accordatore cromatico e stroboscopico preciso al cent; 132 accordature, da Drop D e Open G a DADGAD, più le tue.
• Rilevamento automatico delle corde, con spunta quando sono accordate. Una pennata legge tutte le corde e mostra quale accordare prima.
• Accorda al tatto: il telefono pulsa al battimento tra corda e nota, rallenta quando si avvicinano e si ferma all’accordatura giusta. Puoi accordare senza guardare.
• Chitarre, bassi, violino, violoncello e mandolino 3D con luci da studio e la chiave da girare evidenziata.
• Capotasto, riferimento A4 regolabile, nomi delle note in solfeggio e sargam.

IMPARA SUONANDO
• 526 lezioni in 11 corsi: chitarra, ukulele, basso, violino, violoncello, mandolino, banjo, canto, orecchio, teoria e ritmo. Più raccolte di brani per ukulele, mandolino, violino, violoncello e basso.
• Timbre sente ogni pennata: l’accordo giusto, a tempo, e quale corda non ha suonato. Ogni nota viene valutata al cent e al millisecondo mentre suoni.
• “Mostrami” esegue ogni nuovo accordo su una chitarra 3D, posando le dita in ordine. La pista di note rallenta per te, poi accelera quando migliori.

SUONA BRANI
• Oltre 140 brani con arrangiamenti completi: classici da Jingle Bells ad Amazing Grace e 50 Originals scritti per Timbre in stili attuali.
• Suona con la band in cuffia mentre le parole si illuminano.
• I tuoi brani: incolla o importa uno spartito di accordi, trasponilo, fallo scorrere a tempo e ascolta accanto l’originale su Apple Music.

CONTINUA A SUONARE
• Stelle, XP, missioni quotidiane, serie e distintivi.
• Game Center: lega settimanale di Centro, classifiche dei brani e sfide tra amici.
• Apple Watch: metronomo che senti al polso e pratica di oggi a colpo d’occhio.
• Widget per Home e schermata di blocco, attività in tempo reale e comandi rapidi Siri.
• Metronomo con accenti, suddivisioni e allenamento alla velocità; bordone, esercizi di intonazione, libreria di accordi e scale.
• Orecchio: direzione dell’altezza, intervalli e tipi di accordi, più un corso di 40 lezioni.

INIZIA GRATIS
L’accordatura standard di ogni strumento è gratis; chitarra, basso, ukulele, violino e violoncello sono gratis in tutte le accordature. Anche la prima unità di ogni corso e una selezione di brani sono gratis. Timbre Pro sblocca ogni lezione, brano, accordatura e strumento di pratica. Con le notifiche attive, Timbre ti avvisa due giorni prima che termini una prova gratuita.

Privacy fin dalla progettazione: l’audio viene analizzato sul tuo iPhone, mai registrato né caricato. Niente account o pubblicità.

Gli abbonamenti si rinnovano automaticamente salvo disdetta almeno 24 ore prima della fine del periodo. Gestisci o annulla in qualsiasi momento in Impostazioni → Account Apple → Abbonamenti.
Termini: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: <privacy policy URL>

field_changes.old:
無料チューナー。広告もアカウントも不要。その先には、あなたの演奏を聴くレッスンがあります。

Timbreは精密なチューナーと音楽の先生をひとつにしたアプリ。60種類の楽器をチューニングし、実際に弾きながら演奏の結果を細かく確かめられます。

無料でチューニング
• ギター、ウクレレ、バイオリンからマンドリン、バンジョー、ウード、二胡まで、すべての楽器の標準チューニングが無料。
• セント単位の精度を備えたクロマチック／ストロボチューナー。Drop D、Open G、DADGADなど132種類に加え、自分だけのチューニングも作れます。
• 弦を自動検出し、音が合った弦にチェックを表示。ひと振りですべての弦を読み取り、最初に調整する弦を示します。
• 感覚でチューニング：弦と目標音のうなりに合わせてiPhoneが振動。近づくほどゆっくりになり、合うと止まるので、画面を見ずに調整できます。
• スタジオ照明の3Dギター、ベース、バイオリン、チェロ、マンドリンで、回すペグを表示。
• カポ、調整可能なA4基準音、ソルフェージュとサルガムの音名。

弾きながら学ぶ
• 11コースに526レッスン：ギター、ウクレレ、ベース、バイオリン、チェロ、マンドリン、バンジョー、歌、耳トレ、音楽理論、リズム。ウクレレ、マンドリン、バイオリン、チェロ、ベースの曲集もあります。
• Timbreはストロークごとに、正しいコードか、タイミングが合ったか、どの弦が鳴らなかったかを聴き取ります。各音の高さをセント単位、タイミングをミリ秒単位で判定。
• 「お手本を見る」で新しいコードを3Dギターが実演し、指を置く順番を表示。流れる音符のレーンはあなたに合わせて減速し、上達すると速度を戻します。

曲を演奏
• 140曲以上のフルアレンジ。Jingle BellsからAmazing Graceまでの定番曲と、今のスタイルでTimbreのために書かれた50曲のOriginalsを含みます。
• ヘッドフォンでバンドと一緒に演奏すると、歌詞が光って進みます。
• 自分の曲：コード譜を貼り付けるか読み込み、移調し、テンポに合わせてスクロール。横でApple Musicの原曲を聴けます。

続ける楽しさ
• 星、XP、毎日のクエスト、連続記録、バッジ。
• Game Center：ど真ん中の週間リーグ、曲別ランキング、友達とのチャレンジ。
• Apple Watch：手首で感じるメトロノームと、今日の練習の確認。
• ホーム画面・ロック画面のウィジェット、ライブアクティビティ、Siriショートカット。
• アクセント、細分化、速度トレーナー付きメトロノーム。ドローン、音程トレーナー、コードとスケールのライブラリ。
• 耳トレ：音の上下、音程、コードの種類。40レッスンの耳トレコースもあります。

無料で始める

無料チューナー。広告もアカウントも不要。その先には、あなたの演奏を聴くレッスンがあります。

Timbreは精密なチューナーと音楽の先生をひとつにしたアプリ。60種類の楽器をチューニングし、実際に弾きながら演奏の結果を細かく確かめられます。

無料でチューニング
• ギター、ウクレレ、バイオリンからマンドリン、バンジョー、ウード、二胡まで、すべての楽器の標準チューニングが無料。
• セント単位の精度を備えたクロマチック／ストロボチューナー。Drop D、Open G、DADGADなど132種類に加え、自分だけのチューニングも作れます。
• 弦を自動検出し、音が合った弦にチェックを表示。ひと振りですべての弦を読み取り、最初に調整する弦を示します。

• スタジオ照明の3Dギター、ベース、バイオリン、チェロ、マンドリンで、回すペグを表示。

field_changes.source:
Free tuner, no ads, no account. Then lessons that listen as you play.

Timbre is a precise tuner and a music teacher in one app. Tune any of 60 instruments in seconds, then play real lessons that listen to you and tell you exactly how you did.

TUNE ANYTHING, FREE
• Every instrument's standard tuning is free, from guitar, ukulele and violin to mandolin, banjo, oud and erhu
• A chromatic and strobe tuner with cent-level precision
• 132 tunings, from drop D and open G to DADGAD, plus your own
• Auto string detection, with a check-off as each string locks in
• Strum to tune: one strum reads every string at once and shows which one to tune first
• Tune by feel: the phone pulses with the beat between your string and its note, slower as they meet and still at the lock, so you can tune without looking
• Studio-lit 3D guitars, basses, violin, cello and mandolin, with the peg to turn shown on the headstock
• Capo, adjustable A4 reference, solfège and sargam note names

LEARN BY PLAYING
• 526 lessons in 11 courses: guitar, ukulele, bass, violin, cello, mandolin, banjo, voice, ear training, music theory and rhythm, plus songbooks for ukulele, mandolin, violin, cello and bass
• Timbre hears every strum: the right chord, on time, and which string didn't ring
• Every note judged as you play it, its pitch to the cent and its timing to the millisecond
• "Show me" plays each new chord on a 3D guitar, the fingers landing in order
• A play-along note highway that slows down for you, then speeds back up as you improve

PLAY SONGS
• 140+ songs, each a full arrangement: classics from Jingle Bells to Amazing Grace, and 50 Originals written for Timbre in today's styles
• Play along with the band in your headphones while the words light up
• Your songs: paste or import any chord chart, transpose it, scroll it in time, and listen to the original on Apple Music beside it

KEEP IT GOING
• Stars, XP, daily quests, streaks and badges
• Apple Watch: a metronome you feel on your wrist, and today's practice at a glance
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, a Live Activity and Siri shortcuts

PRACTICE TOOLS
• Metronome with accents, subdivisions and a speed trainer
• Drone, an intonation trainer, and a chord and scale library
• Ear training: pitch direction, intervals and chord quality, plus a 40-lesson ear course

FREE TO START
Every instrument's standard tuning is free, and guitar, bass, ukulele, violin and cello tune free in every tuning. The first unit of every course and a shelf of songs are free too. Timbre Pro unlocks every lesson and song, every tuning and the full practice set. With notifications on, Timbre reminds you two days before a free trial ends.

Private by design: live microphone audio is analyzed on your device, never recorded or uploaded. No account and no ads.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions.

field_changes.old:
ಉಚಿತ ಟ್ಯೂನರ್. ಜಾಹೀರಾತು ಅಥವಾ ಖಾತೆ ಇಲ್ಲ. ನಂತರ ನಿಮ್ಮ ವಾದನ ಕೇಳುವ ಪಾಠಗಳು.

Timbre ನಿಖರ ಟ್ಯೂನರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಗೀತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕನನ್ನು ಒಗ್ಗೂಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. 60 ವಾದ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದನ್ನಾದರೂ ಕ್ಷಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಶ್ರುತಿ ಮಾಡಿ; ನಿಮ್ಮ ವಾದನ ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಖರ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆ ನೀಡುವ ಪಾಠಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನುಡಿಸಿ.

ಉಚಿತವಾಗಿ ಶ್ರುತಿ ಮಾಡಿ
• ಗಿಟಾರ್, ಯುಕುಲೆಲೆ, ವಯಲಿನ್‌ನಿಂದ ಮ್ಯಾಂಡೊಲಿನ್, ಬ್ಯಾಂಜೊ, ಊದ್ ಮತ್ತು ಎರ್ಹುವರೆಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ವಾದ್ಯದ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ಶ್ರುತಿ ಉಚಿತ.
• ಸೆಂಟ್ ಮಟ್ಟದ ನಿಖರತೆಯ ಕ್ರೊಮ್ಯಾಟಿಕ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಟ್ರೋಬ್ ಟ್ಯೂನರ್. Drop D, Open G, DADGAD ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ 132 ಶ್ರುತಿಗಳು; ಜೊತೆಗೆ ನಿಮ್ಮದೇ ಶ್ರುತಿಗಳನ್ನೂ ರಚಿಸಬಹುದು.
• ತಂತಿಯ ಸ್ವಯಂ ಗುರುತಿಸುವಿಕೆ; ಶ್ರುತಿ ಸರಿಯಾದಾಗ ಗುರುತು. ಒಂದೇ ಸ್ಟ್ರಮ್ ಎಲ್ಲ ತಂತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಓದಿ ಮೊದಲು ಯಾವುದನ್ನು ಶ್ರುತಿ ಮಾಡಬೇಕೆಂದು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
• ಸ್ಪರ್ಶದಿಂದ ಶ್ರುತಿ ಮಾಡಿ: ತಂತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಗುರಿ ಸ್ವರದ ನಡುವಿನ ಮಿಡಿತದಂತೆ ಫೋನ್ ಕಂಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಅವು ಹತ್ತಿರವಾದಂತೆ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ, ಹೊಂದಿದಾಗ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ. ನೋಡದೆ ಶ್ರುತಿ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು.
• ಸ್ಟುಡಿಯೊ ಬೆಳಕಿನ 3D ಗಿಟಾರ್, ಬಾಸ್, ವಯಲಿನ್, ಸೆಲ್ಲೋ ಮತ್ತು ಮ್ಯಾಂಡೊಲಿನ್; ಹೆಡ್‌ಸ್ಟಾಕ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ತಿರುಗಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಪೆಗ್ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
• ಕ್ಯಾಪೊ, ಬದಲಿಸಬಹುದಾದ A4 ಆಧಾರ ಸ್ವರ, ಸೊಲ್ಫೇಜ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸರಗಮ್ ಸ್ವರನಾಮಗಳು.

ನುಡಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ
• 11 ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 526 ಪಾಠಗಳು: ಗಿಟಾರ್, ಯುಕುಲೆಲೆ, ಬಾಸ್, ವಯಲಿನ್, ಸೆಲ್ಲೋ, ಮ್ಯಾಂಡೊಲಿನ್, ಬ್ಯಾಂಜೊ, ಗಾಯನ, ಶ್ರವಣ ತರಬೇತಿ, ಸಂಗೀತ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತ ಮತ್ತು ಲಯ. ಯುಕುಲೆಲೆ, ಮ್ಯಾಂಡೊಲಿನ್, ವಯಲಿನ್, ಸೆಲ್ಲೋ ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಸ್ ಹಾಡಿನ ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳೂ ಇವೆ.
• Timbre ಪ್ರತಿ ಸ್ಟ್ರಮ್ ಕೇಳುತ್ತದೆ: ಸರಿಯಾದ ಕಾರ್ಡ್, ಸಮಯ ಮತ್ತು ಮಿಡಿಯದ ತಂತಿ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಸ್ವರದ ಎತ್ತರ ಸೆಂಟ್ ಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ, ಸಮಯ ಮಿಲಿಸೆಕೆಂಡ್ ಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
• “ತೋರಿಸಿ” ಹೊಸ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಅನ್ನು 3D ಗಿಟಾರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನುಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಬೆರಳುಗಳು ಕ್ರಮವಾಗಿ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಜೊತೆಗೆ ನುಡಿಸುವ ಸ್ವರಪಥ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ, ಸುಧಾರಿಸಿದಂತೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ವೇಗವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

ಹಾಡುಗಳನ್ನು ನುಡಿಸಿ
• 140+ ಹಾಡುಗಳು, ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದಕ್ಕೂ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಸಂಯೋಜನೆ: Jingle Bellsನಿಂದ Amazing Graceವರೆಗೆ ಜನಪ್ರಿಯ ಹಳೆಯ ಹಾಡುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಇಂದಿನ ಶೈಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ Timbreಗಾಗಿ ಬರೆದ 50 ಮೂಲ ಹಾಡುಗಳು.
• ಹೆಡ್‌ಫೋನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಬ್ಯಾಂಡ್ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ನುಡಿಸಿ; ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಹೊಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
• ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹಾಡುಗಳು: ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಚಾರ್ಟ್ ಅಂಟಿಸಿ ಅಥವಾ ಆಮದು ಮಾಡಿ, ಶ್ರುತಿ ಬದಲಿಸಿ, ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಸ್ಕ್ರೋಲ್ ಮಾಡಿ; ಪಕ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿ Apple Musicನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂಲ ಹಾಡು ಕೇಳಿ.

ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಿ
• ನಕ್ಷತ್ರಗಳು, XP, ದಿನನಿತ್ಯದ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳು, ಸತತ ದಿನಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ಯಾಡ್ಜ್‌ಗಳು.
• Game Center: ವಾರದ ನಿಖರ ಗುರಿ ಲೀಗ್, ಹಾಡಿನ ಲೀಡರ್‌ಬೋರ್ಡ್‌ಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರ ಸವಾಲುಗಳು.
• Apple Watch: ಮಣಿಕಟ್ಟಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅನುಭವಿಸುವ ಮೆಟ್ರೊನೋಮ್ ಮತ್ತು ಇಂದಿನ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸದ ನೋಟ.
• ಹೋಮ್ ಮತ್ತು ಲಾಕ್ ಸ್ಕ್ರೀನ್ ವಿಜೆಟ್‌ಗಳು, ಲೈವ್ ಆ್ಯಕ್ಟಿವಿಟಿ ಮತ್ತು Siri ಶಾರ್ಟ್‌ಕಟ್‌ಗಳು.
• ಒತ್ತು, ಉಪವಿಭಾಗ ಮತ್ತು ವೇಗ ತರಬೇತಿದಾರ ಇರುವ ಮೆಟ್ರೊನೋಮ್; ನಿರಂತರ ಸ್ವರ, ಸ್ವರಶುದ್ಧತೆ ತರಬೇತಿದಾರ, ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಕೇಲ್ ಸಂಗ್ರಹ.
• ಶ್ರವಣ ತರಬೇತಿ: ಸ್ವರದ ದಿಕ್ಕು, ಅಂತರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ವಿಧಗಳು; 40 ಪಾಠಗಳ ಶ್ರವಣ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಕೂಡ.

ಉಚಿತವಾಗಿ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಿ
ಪ್ರತಿ ವಾದ್ಯದ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ಶ್ರುತಿ ಉಚಿತ. ಗಿಟಾರ್, ಬಾಸ್, ಯುಕುಲೆಲೆ, ವಯಲಿನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸೆಲ್ಲೋದ ಎಲ್ಲ ಶ್ರುತಿಗಳು ಉಚಿತ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ನ ಮೊದಲ ಘಟಕ ಮತ್ತು ಕೆಲವು ಹಾಡುಗಳೂ ಉಚಿತ. Timbre Pro ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಪಾಠ, ಹಾಡು, ಶ್ರುತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಸಾಧನಗಳನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಸೂಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಆನ್ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಉಚಿತ ಪ್ರಯೋಗ ಮುಗಿಯುವ ಎರಡು ದಿನ ಮೊದಲು Timbre ನೆನಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

ಗೌಪ್ಯತೆಯ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ: ಆಡಿಯೊ ನಿಮ್ಮ iPhoneನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ; ಎಂದಿಗೂ ರೆಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಅಥವಾ ಅಪ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಆಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಖಾತೆ ಅಥವಾ ಜಾಹೀರಾತು ಇಲ್ಲ.

ಅವಧಿ ಮುಗಿಯುವ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ 24 ಗಂಟೆ ಮೊದಲು ರದ್ದು ಮಾಡದಿದ್ದರೆ ಚಂದಾದಾರಿಕೆ ಸ್ವಯಂ ನವೀಕರಣವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸೆಟ್ಟಿಂಗ್‌ಗಳು → Apple ಖಾತೆ → ಚಂದಾದಾರಿಕೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವಾಗ ಬೇಕಾದರೂ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸಿ ಅಥವಾ ರದ್ದುಮಾಡಿ.

ಉಚಿತ ಟ್ಯೂನರ್. ಜಾಹೀರಾತು ಅಥವಾ ಖಾತೆ ಇಲ್ಲ. ನಂತರ ನಿಮ್ಮ ವಾದನ ಕೇಳುವ ಪಾಠಗಳು.

Timbre ನಿಖರ ಟ್ಯೂನರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಗೀತ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕನನ್ನು ಒಗ್ಗೂಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. 60 ವಾದ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದನ್ನಾದರೂ ಕ್ಷಣಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಶ್ರುತಿ ಮಾಡಿ; ನಿಮ್ಮ ವಾದನ ಕೇಳಿ ನಿಖರ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆ ನೀಡುವ ಪಾಠಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನುಡಿಸಿ.

ಉಚಿತವಾಗಿ ಶ್ರುತಿ ಮಾಡಿ
• ಗಿಟಾರ್, ಯುಕುಲೆಲೆ, ವಯಲಿನ್‌ನಿಂದ ಮ್ಯಾಂಡೊಲಿನ್, ಬ್ಯಾಂಜೊ, ಊದ್ ಮತ್ತು ಎರ್ಹುವರೆಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ವಾದ್ಯದ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ಶ್ರುತಿ ಉಚಿತ.
• ಸೆಂಟ್ ಮಟ್ಟದ ನಿಖರತೆಯ ಕ್ರೊಮ್ಯಾಟಿಕ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಟ್ರೋಬ್ ಟ್ಯೂನರ್. Drop D, Open G, DADGAD ಸೇರಿದಂತೆ 132 ಶ್ರುತಿಗಳು; ಜೊತೆಗೆ ನಿಮ್ಮದೇ ಶ್ರುತಿಗಳನ್ನೂ ರಚಿಸಬಹುದು.
• ತಂತಿಯ ಸ್ವಯಂ ಗುರುತಿಸುವಿಕೆ; ಶ್ರುತಿ ಸರಿಯಾದಾಗ ಗುರುತು. ಒಂದೇ ಸ್ಟ್ರಮ್ ಎಲ್ಲ ತಂತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಓದಿ ಮೊದಲು ಯಾವುದನ್ನು ಶ್ರುತಿ ಮಾಡಬೇಕೆಂದು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
• ಸ್ಪರ್ಶದಿಂದ ಶ್ರುತಿ ಮಾಡಿ: ತಂತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಗುರಿ ಸ್ವರದ ನಡುವಿನ ಮಿಡಿತದಂತೆ ಫೋನ್ ಕಂಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಅವು ಹತ್ತಿರವಾದಂತೆ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ, ಹೊಂದಿದಾಗ ನಿಲ್ಲುತ್ತದೆ. ನೋಡದೆ ಶ್ರುತಿ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು.
• ಸ್ಟುಡಿಯೊ ಬೆಳಕಿನ 3D ಗಿಟಾರ್, ಬಾಸ್, ವಯಲಿನ್, ಸೆಲ್ಲೋ ಮತ್ತು ಮ್ಯಾಂಡೊಲಿನ್; ಹೆಡ್‌ಸ್ಟಾಕ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ತಿರುಗಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಪೆಗ್ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
• ಕ್ಯಾಪೊ, ಬದಲಿಸಬಹುದಾದ A4 ಆಧಾರ ಸ್ವರ, ಸೊಲ್ಫೇಜ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸರಗಮ್ ಸ್ವರನಾಮಗಳು.

ನುಡಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ
• 11 ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 526 ಪಾಠಗಳು: ಗಿಟಾರ್, ಯುಕುಲೆಲೆ, ಬಾಸ್, ವಯಲಿನ್, ಸೆಲ್ಲೋ, ಮ್ಯಾಂಡೊಲಿನ್, ಬ್ಯಾಂಜೊ, ಗಾಯನ, ಶ್ರವಣ ತರಬೇತಿ, ಸಂಗೀತ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತ ಮತ್ತು ಲಯ. ಯುಕುಲೆಲೆ, ಮ್ಯಾಂಡೊಲಿನ್, ವಯಲಿನ್, ಸೆಲ್ಲೋ ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಸ್ ಹಾಡಿನ ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳೂ ಇವೆ.
• Timbre ಪ್ರತಿ ಸ್ಟ್ರಮ್ ಕೇಳುತ್ತದೆ: ಸರಿಯಾದ ಕಾರ್ಡ್, ಸಮಯ ಮತ್ತು ಮಿಡಿಯದ ತಂತಿ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಸ್ವರದ ಎತ್ತರ ಸೆಂಟ್ ಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ, ಸಮಯ ಮಿಲಿಸೆಕೆಂಡ್ ಮಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
• “ತೋರಿಸಿ” ಹೊಸ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಅನ್ನು 3D ಗಿಟಾರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನುಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಬೆರಳುಗಳು ಕ್ರಮವಾಗಿ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಜೊತೆಗೆ ನುಡಿಸುವ ಸ್ವರಪಥ ನಿಮಗಾಗಿ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ, ಸುಧಾರಿಸಿದಂತೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ವೇಗವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

ಹಾಡುಗಳನ್ನು ನುಡಿಸಿ
• 140+ ಹಾಡುಗಳು, ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದಕ್ಕೂ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಸಂಯೋಜನೆ: Jingle Bellsನಿಂದ Amazing Graceವರೆಗೆ ಜನಪ್ರಿಯ ಹಳೆಯ ಹಾಡುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಇಂದಿನ ಶೈಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ Timbreಗಾಗಿ ಬರೆದ 50 ಮೂಲ ಹಾಡುಗಳು.
• ಹೆಡ್‌ಫೋನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಬ್ಯಾಂಡ್ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ನುಡಿಸಿ; ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ ಹೊಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
• ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹಾಡುಗಳು: ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಚಾರ್ಟ್ ಅಂಟಿಸಿ ಅಥವಾ ಆಮದು ಮಾಡಿ, ಶ್ರುತಿ ಬದಲಿಸಿ, ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಸ್ಕ್ರೋಲ್ ಮಾಡಿ; ಪಕ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿ Apple Musicನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂಲ ಹಾಡು ಕೇಳಿ.

ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಿ

• ಶ್ರವಣ ತರಬೇತಿ: ಸ್ವರದ ದಿಕ್ಕು, ಅಂತರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ವಿಧಗಳು; 40 ಪಾಠಗಳ ಶ್ರವಣ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಕೂಡ.

Timbre Pro ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಪಾಠ, ಹಾಡು, ಶ್ರುತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಸಾಧನಗಳನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಸೂಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಆನ್ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಉಚಿತ ಪ್ರಯೋಗ ಮುಗಿಯುವ ಎರಡು ದಿನ ಮೊದಲು Timbre ನೆನಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

field_changes.source:
Free tuner, no ads, no account. Then lessons that listen as you play.

Timbre is a precise tuner and a music teacher in one app. Tune any of 60 instruments in seconds, then play real lessons that listen to you and tell you exactly how you did.

TUNE ANYTHING, FREE
• Every instrument's standard tuning is free, from guitar, ukulele and violin to mandolin, banjo, oud and erhu
• A chromatic and strobe tuner with cent-level precision
• 132 tunings, from drop D and open G to DADGAD, plus your own
• Auto string detection, with a check-off as each string locks in
• Strum to tune: one strum reads every string at once and shows which one to tune first
• Tune by feel: the phone pulses with the beat between your string and its note, slower as they meet and still at the lock, so you can tune without looking
• Studio-lit 3D guitars, basses, violin, cello and mandolin, with the peg to turn shown on the headstock
• Capo, adjustable A4 reference, solfège and sargam note names

LEARN BY PLAYING
• 526 lessons in 11 courses: guitar, ukulele, bass, violin, cello, mandolin, banjo, voice, ear training, music theory and rhythm, plus songbooks for ukulele, mandolin, violin, cello and bass
• Timbre hears every strum: the right chord, on time, and which string didn't ring
• Every note judged as you play it, its pitch to the cent and its timing to the millisecond
• "Show me" plays each new chord on a 3D guitar, the fingers landing in order
• A play-along note highway that slows down for you, then speeds back up as you improve

PLAY SONGS
• 140+ songs, each a full arrangement: classics from Jingle Bells to Amazing Grace, and 50 Originals written for Timbre in today's styles
• Play along with the band in your headphones while the words light up
• Your songs: paste or import any chord chart, transpose it, scroll it in time, and listen to the original on Apple Music beside it

KEEP IT GOING
• Stars, XP, daily quests, streaks and badges
• Apple Watch: a metronome you feel on your wrist, and today's practice at a glance
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, a Live Activity and Siri shortcuts

PRACTICE TOOLS
• Metronome with accents, subdivisions and a speed trainer
• Drone, an intonation trainer, and a chord and scale library
• Ear training: pitch direction, intervals and chord quality, plus a 40-lesson ear course

FREE TO START
Every instrument's standard tuning is free, and guitar, bass, ukulele, violin and cello tune free in every tuning. The first unit of every course and a shelf of songs are free too. Timbre Pro unlocks every lesson and song, every tuning and the full practice set. With notifications on, Timbre reminds you two days before a free trial ends.

Private by design: live microphone audio is analyzed on your device, never recorded or uploaded. No account and no ads.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions.

무료 튜너. 광고도 계정도 없어요. 그다음은 연주를 듣는 레슨입니다.

Timbre는 정밀한 튜너와 음악 선생님을 하나로 담았습니다. 60가지 악기를 조율하고 실제로 연주하며 결과를 자세히 확인하세요.

무료로 조율하기
• 기타, 우쿨렐레, 바이올린부터 만돌린, 밴조, 우드, 얼후까지 모든 악기의 표준 튜닝이 무료입니다.
• 센트 단위로 정밀한 크로매틱 및 스트로브 튜너. Drop D, Open G, DADGAD 등 132가지 튜닝과 나만의 튜닝을 지원합니다.

• Apple Watch: 손목으로 느끼는 메트로놈과 한눈에 보는 오늘의 연습.
• 홈 화면과 잠금 화면 위젯, 실시간 현황, Siri 단축어.
• 강세, 세분 박자, 속도 훈련 기능의 메트로놈. 드론, 음정 훈련, 코드 및 음계 라이브러리.
• 청음: 음높이 방향, 음정, 코드 성질과 40개 레슨의 청음 코스.

field_changes.source:
Free tuner, no ads, no account. Then lessons that listen as you play.

Timbre is a precise tuner and a music teacher in one app. Tune any of 60 instruments in seconds, then play real lessons that listen to you and tell you exactly how you did.

TUNE ANYTHING, FREE
• Every instrument's standard tuning is free, from guitar, ukulele and violin to mandolin, banjo, oud and erhu
• A chromatic and strobe tuner with cent-level precision
• 132 tunings, from drop D and open G to DADGAD, plus your own
• Auto string detection, with a check-off as each string locks in
• Strum to tune: one strum reads every string at once and shows which one to tune first
• Tune by feel: the phone pulses with the beat between your string and its note, slower as they meet and still at the lock, so you can tune without looking
• Studio-lit 3D guitars, basses, violin, cello and mandolin, with the peg to turn shown on the headstock
• Capo, adjustable A4 reference, solfège and sargam note names

LEARN BY PLAYING
• 526 lessons in 11 courses: guitar, ukulele, bass, violin, cello, mandolin, banjo, voice, ear training, music theory and rhythm, plus songbooks for ukulele, mandolin, violin, cello and bass
• Timbre hears every strum: the right chord, on time, and which string didn't ring
• Every note judged as you play it, its pitch to the cent and its timing to the millisecond
• "Show me" plays each new chord on a 3D guitar, the fingers landing in order
• A play-along note highway that slows down for you, then speeds back up as you improve

PLAY SONGS
• 140+ songs, each a full arrangement: classics from Jingle Bells to Amazing Grace, and 50 Originals written for Timbre in today's styles
• Play along with the band in your headphones while the words light up
• Your songs: paste or import any chord chart, transpose it, scroll it in time, and listen to the original on Apple Music beside it

KEEP IT GOING
• Stars, XP, daily quests, streaks and badges
• Apple Watch: a metronome you feel on your wrist, and today's practice at a glance
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, a Live Activity and Siri shortcuts

PRACTICE TOOLS
• Metronome with accents, subdivisions and a speed trainer
• Drone, an intonation trainer, and a chord and scale library
• Ear training: pitch direction, intervals and chord quality, plus a 40-lesson ear course

FREE TO START
Every instrument's standard tuning is free, and guitar, bass, ukulele, violin and cello tune free in every tuning. The first unit of every course and a shelf of songs are free too. Timbre Pro unlocks every lesson and song, every tuning and the full practice set. With notifications on, Timbre reminds you two days before a free trial ends.

Private by design: live microphone audio is analyzed on your device, never recorded or uploaded. No account and no ads.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions.

Privacy: https://timbre-support.timbre.workers.dev/privacy

സൗജന്യ ട്യൂണർ. പരസ്യമോ അക്കൗണ്ടോ വേണ്ട. പിന്നെ നിങ്ങൾ വായിക്കുന്നത് കേൾക്കുന്ന പാഠങ്ങൾ.

Timbre കൃത്യമായ ട്യൂണറും സംഗീത അധ്യാപകനും ഒന്നിച്ചാണ്. 60 വാദ്യങ്ങളിൽ ഏതിനെയും നിമിഷങ്ങളിൽ ട്യൂൺ ചെയ്യൂ; വായന കേട്ട് കൃത്യമായ പ്രതികരണം നൽകുന്ന പാഠങ്ങളിൽ പഠിക്കൂ.

സൗജന്യമായി ട്യൂൺ ചെയ്യൂ
• ഗിറ്റാർ, യുകുലേലെ, വയലിൻ മുതൽ മാൻഡലിൻ, ബാൻജോ, ഊദ്, എർഹു വരെ എല്ലാ വാദ്യങ്ങളുടെയും സാധാരണ ട്യൂണിംഗ് സൗജന്യം.
• സെന്റ് വരെ കൃത്യതയുള്ള ക്രോമാറ്റിക്, സ്ട്രോബ് ട്യൂണർ. Drop D, Open G, DADGAD ഉൾപ്പെടെ 132 ട്യൂണിംഗുകൾ, സ്വന്തം ട്യൂണിംഗുകളും.
• തന്ത്രികളെ സ്വയം തിരിച്ചറിയും; ശ്രുതി ചേരുമ്പോൾ അടയാളം. ഒറ്റ സ്ട്രം എല്ലാ തന്ത്രികളും വായിച്ച് ആദ്യം ഏത് ട്യൂൺ ചെയ്യണമെന്ന് കാണിക്കും.
• അനുഭവിച്ച് ട്യൂൺ ചെയ്യൂ: തന്ത്രിക്കും ലക്ഷ്യസ്വരത്തിനുമിടയിലെ സ്പന്ദനത്തിനൊപ്പം ഫോൺ വിറയ്ക്കുന്നു; അവ അടുക്കുമ്പോൾ മന്ദമാകുകയും ചേരുമ്പോൾ നിൽക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു. നോക്കാതെ ട്യൂൺ ചെയ്യാം.
• സ്റ്റുഡിയോ വെളിച്ചത്തിലുള്ള 3D ഗിറ്റാറുകൾ, ബാസുകൾ, വയലിൻ, ചെല്ലോ, മാൻഡലിൻ; ഹെഡ്‌സ്റ്റോക്കിൽ തിരിക്കേണ്ട പെഗ് കാണിക്കും.
• കാപ്പോ, മാറ്റാവുന്ന A4 റഫറൻസ്, സോൾഫേജ്, സർഗം സ്വരനാമങ്ങൾ.

വായിച്ച് പഠിക്കൂ
• 11 കോഴ്സുകളിൽ 526 പാഠങ്ങൾ: ഗിറ്റാർ, യുകുലേലെ, ബാസ്, വയലിൻ, ചെല്ലോ, മാൻഡലിൻ, ബാൻജോ, ആലാപനം, ശ്രവണ പരിശീലനം, സംഗീത സിദ്ധാന്തം, താളം. യുകുലേലെ, മാൻഡലിൻ, വയലിൻ, ചെല്ലോ, ബാസ് ഗാനപുസ്തകങ്ങളും.
• Timbre ഓരോ സ്ട്രവും കേൾക്കും: ശരിയായ കോർഡ്, സമയം, മുഴങ്ങാതിരുന്ന തന്ത്രി. ഓരോ സ്വരത്തിന്റെയും ഉയരം സെന്റിലും സമയം മില്ലിസെക്കൻഡിലും വിലയിരുത്തും.

പാട്ടുകൾ വായിക്കൂ
• 140+ പാട്ടുകൾ, ഓരോന്നിനും പൂർണ്ണ അറേഞ്ച്മെന്റ്: Jingle Bells മുതൽ Amazing Grace വരെയുള്ള പഴയ പ്രിയഗാനങ്ങളും ഇന്നത്തെ ശൈലികളിൽ Timbreക്കായി എഴുതിയ 50 മൗലിക ഗാനങ്ങളും.

• നിങ്ങളുടെ പാട്ടുകൾ: കോർഡ് ചാർട്ട് ഒട്ടിക്കുകയോ ഇറക്കുമതി ചെയ്യുകയോ ചെയ്യൂ, ശ്രുതി മാറ്റൂ, സമയത്തിനൊപ്പം സ്ക്രോൾ ചെയ്യൂ; അരികിൽ Apple Musicൽ അസൽ ഗാനം കേൾക്കൂ.

പരിശീലനം തുടരൂ
• നക്ഷത്രങ്ങൾ, XP, ദൈനംദിന ദൗത്യങ്ങൾ, തുടർച്ചകൾ, ബാഡ്ജുകൾ.

Timbre Pro എല്ലാ പാഠങ്ങളും പാട്ടുകളും ട്യൂണിംഗുകളും പരിശീലന ഉപകരണങ്ങളും തുറക്കും. അറിയിപ്പുകൾ ഓണാണെങ്കിൽ സൗജന്യ പരീക്ഷണം അവസാനിക്കുന്നതിന് രണ്ട് ദിവസം മുമ്പ് Timbre ഓർമ്മിപ്പിക്കും.

സ്വകാര്യത മുൻനിർത്തി: ഓഡിയോ നിങ്ങളുടെ iPhoneൽ വിശകലനം ചെയ്യുന്നു; ഒരിക്കലും റെക്കോർഡ് ചെയ്യുകയോ അപ്‌ലോഡ് ചെയ്യുകയോ ഇല്ല. അക്കൗണ്ടോ പരസ്യമോ ഇല്ല.

കാലാവധി അവസാനിക്കുന്നതിന് കുറഞ്ഞത് 24 മണിക്കൂർ മുമ്പ് റദ്ദാക്കാത്തപക്ഷം സബ്സ്ക്രിപ്ഷൻ സ്വയം പുതുക്കും. ക്രമീകരണങ്ങൾ → Apple അക്കൗണ്ട് → സബ്സ്ക്രിപ്ഷനുകൾ വഴി എപ്പോൾ വേണമെങ്കിലും നിയന്ത്രിക്കുകയോ റദ്ദാക്കുകയോ ചെയ്യൂ.

പരിശീലനം തുടരൂ

എല്ലാ വാദ്യങ്ങളുടെയും സാധാരണ ട്യൂണിംഗ് സൗജന്യം. ഗിറ്റാർ, ബാസ്, യുകുലേലെ, വയലിൻ, ചെല്ലോ എന്നിവയുടെ എല്ലാ ട്യൂണിംഗും സൗജന്യം. ഓരോ കോഴ്സിന്റെയും ആദ്യ യൂണിറ്റും ചില പാട്ടുകളും സൗജന്യം. കാലാവധി അവസാനിക്കുന്നതിന് കുറഞ്ഞത് 24 മണിക്കൂർ മുമ്പ് റദ്ദാക്കാത്തപക്ഷം സബ്സ്ക്രിപ്ഷൻ സ്വയം പുതുക്കും. ക്രമീകരണങ്ങൾ → Apple അക്കൗണ്ട് → സബ്സ്ക്രിപ്ഷനുകൾ വഴി എപ്പോൾ വേണമെങ്കിലും നിയന്ത്രിക്കുകയോ റദ്ദാക്കുകയോ ചെയ്യൂ.

field_changes.source:
Free tuner, no ads, no account. Then lessons that listen as you play.

Timbre is a precise tuner and a music teacher in one app. Tune any of 60 instruments in seconds, then play real lessons that listen to you and tell you exactly how you did.

TUNE ANYTHING, FREE
• Every instrument's standard tuning is free, from guitar, ukulele and violin to mandolin, banjo, oud and erhu
• A chromatic and strobe tuner with cent-level precision
• 132 tunings, from drop D and open G to DADGAD, plus your own
• Auto string detection, with a check-off as each string locks in
• Strum to tune: one strum reads every string at once and shows which one to tune first
• Tune by feel: the phone pulses with the beat between your string and its note, slower as they meet and still at the lock, so you can tune without looking
• Studio-lit 3D guitars, basses, violin, cello and mandolin, with the peg to turn shown on the headstock
• Capo, adjustable A4 reference, solfège and sargam note names

LEARN BY PLAYING
• 526 lessons in 11 courses: guitar, ukulele, bass, violin, cello, mandolin, banjo, voice, ear training, music theory and rhythm, plus songbooks for ukulele, mandolin, violin, cello and bass
• Timbre hears every strum: the right chord, on time, and which string didn't ring
• Every note judged as you play it, its pitch to the cent and its timing to the millisecond
• "Show me" plays each new chord on a 3D guitar, the fingers landing in order
• A play-along note highway that slows down for you, then speeds back up as you improve

PLAY SONGS
• 140+ songs, each a full arrangement: classics from Jingle Bells to Amazing Grace, and 50 Originals written for Timbre in today's styles
• Play along with the band in your headphones while the words light up
• Your songs: paste or import any chord chart, transpose it, scroll it in time, and listen to the original on Apple Music beside it

KEEP IT GOING
• Stars, XP, daily quests, streaks and badges
• Apple Watch: a metronome you feel on your wrist, and today's practice at a glance
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, a Live Activity and Siri shortcuts

PRACTICE TOOLS
• Metronome with accents, subdivisions and a speed trainer
• Drone, an intonation trainer, and a chord and scale library
• Ear training: pitch direction, intervals and chord quality, plus a 40-lesson ear course

FREE TO START
Every instrument's standard tuning is free, and guitar, bass, ukulele, violin and cello tune free in every tuning. The first unit of every course and a shelf of songs are free too. Timbre Pro unlocks every lesson and song, every tuning and the full practice set. With notifications on, Timbre reminds you two days before a free trial ends.

Private by design: live microphone audio is analyzed on your device, never recorded or uploaded. No account and no ads.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions.

Privacy: https://timbre-support.timbre.workers.dev/privacy
field_changes.old:
मोफत ट्यूनर, जाहिरात नाही, खाते नाही. आणि तुमचे वादन ऐकणारे धडे.

Timbre म्हणजे अचूक ट्यूनर आणि संगीत शिक्षक एकत्र. 60 वाद्यांपैकी कोणतेही काही सेकंदांत ट्यून करा, मग तुमचे वादन ऐकून नेमका प्रतिसाद देणाऱ्या धड्यांत वाजवा.

मोफत ट्यूनिंग
• गिटार, युकुलेले, व्हायोलिनपासून मँडोलिन, बँजो, ऊद आणि एरहूपर्यंत प्रत्येक वाद्याचे प्रमाणित ट्यूनिंग मोफत.
• सेंटपर्यंत अचूक क्रोमॅटिक आणि स्ट्रोब ट्यूनर; Drop D, Open G, DADGAD सहित 132 ट्यूनिंग आणि तुमची स्वतःची ट्यूनिंग.
• तारांची आपोआप ओळख आणि सुरात आल्यावर खूण. एका स्ट्रममध्ये सर्व तारा वाचा आणि आधी कोणती ट्यून करायची ते पाहा.
• स्पर्शाने ट्यून करा: तार आणि तिचा लक्ष्य स्वर यांतील स्पंदनाप्रमाणे फोन थरथरतो; स्वर जवळ येताना हळू होतो आणि जुळल्यावर थांबतो. न पाहताही ट्यून करा.
• स्टुडिओ प्रकाशातील 3D गिटार, बास, व्हायोलिन, सेलो आणि मँडोलिन; हेडस्टॉकवर फिरवायची खुंटी दिसते.
• कॅपो, बदलता A4 संदर्भ, सोल्फेज आणि सरगम स्वरनावे.

वाजवून शिका
• 11 अभ्यासक्रमांत 526 धडे: गिटार, युकुलेले, बास, व्हायोलिन, सेलो, मँडोलिन, बँजो, गायन, श्रवण प्रशिक्षण, संगीत सिद्धांत आणि लय. युकुलेले, मँडोलिन, व्हायोलिन, सेलो आणि बासच्या गीतपुस्तिकाही.
• Timbre प्रत्येक स्ट्रम ऐकतो: योग्य कॉर्ड, वेळ आणि कोणती तार वाजली नाही. प्रत्येक स्वराची उंची सेंटपर्यंत व वेळ मिलिसेकंदापर्यंत तपासली जाते.
• “दाखवा” प्रत्येक नवा कॉर्ड 3D गिटारवर वाजवतो, बोटे क्रमाने बसतात. सोबत वाजवण्याचा स्वरमार्ग तुमच्यासाठी हळू होतो आणि सुधारल्यावर पुन्हा वेगवान होतो.

गाणी वाजवा
• 140+ गाणी, प्रत्येकाचे पूर्ण अरेंजमेंट: Jingle Bells ते Amazing Grace अशी जुनी लोकप्रिय गाणी आणि आजच्या शैलीत Timbreसाठी लिहिलेली 50 मूळ गाणी.
• हेडफोनमध्ये बँडसोबत वाजवा, शब्द उजळत जातात.
• तुमची गाणी: कॉर्ड चार्ट पेस्ट किंवा आयात करा, स्वरांतर करा, वेळेनुसार स्क्रोल करा आणि शेजारी Apple Musicवर मूळ गाणे ऐका.

सराव सुरू ठेवा
• तारे, XP, रोजची आव्हाने, सलग दिवस आणि बॅज.
• Game Center: साप्ताहिक अचूक नेम लीग, गाण्यांचे लीडरबोर्ड आणि मित्रांची आव्हाने.
• Apple Watch: मनगटावर जाणवणारा मेट्रोनोम आणि आजचा सराव एका नजरेत.
• होम व लॉक स्क्रीन विजेट, लाइव्ह ॲक्टिव्हिटी आणि Siri शॉर्टकट.
• जोर, उपविभाग व वेग प्रशिक्षक असलेला मेट्रोनोम; आधार स्वर, स्वरशुद्धता प्रशिक्षक, कॉर्ड व स्केल संग्रह.
• श्रवण प्रशिक्षण: स्वराची दिशा, अंतराल आणि कॉर्ड प्रकार; 40 धड्यांचा श्रवण अभ्यासक्रमही.

मोफत सुरुवात
प्रत्येक वाद्याचे प्रमाणित ट्यूनिंग मोफत आहे. गिटार, बास, युकुलेले, व्हायोलिन आणि सेलोची सर्व ट्यूनिंग मोफत. प्रत्येक अभ्यासक्रमाचा पहिला घटक आणि काही गाणीही मोफत. Timbre Pro सर्व धडे, गाणी, ट्यूनिंग आणि सराव साधने उघडतो. सूचना चालू असतील तर मोफत चाचणी संपण्याच्या दोन दिवस आधी Timbre आठवण करून देतो.

गोपनीयता जपणारी रचना: ऑडिओ तुमच्या iPhoneवर तपासला जातो, कधीही रेकॉर्ड किंवा अपलोड होत नाही. खाते नाही, जाहिरात नाही.

कालावधी संपण्याच्या किमान 24 तास आधी रद्द न केल्यास सदस्यता आपोआप नूतनीकृत होते. सेटिंग्ज → Apple खाते → सदस्यता येथे कधीही व्यवस्थापित किंवा रद्द करा.
अटी: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
गोपनीयता: <privacy policy URL>

field_changes.source:
Free tuner, no ads, no account. Then lessons that listen as you play.

Timbre is a precise tuner and a music teacher in one app. Tune any of 60 instruments in seconds, then play real lessons that listen to you and tell you exactly how you did.

TUNE ANYTHING, FREE
• Every instrument's standard tuning is free, from guitar, ukulele and violin to mandolin, banjo, oud and erhu
• A chromatic and strobe tuner with cent-level precision
• 132 tunings, from drop D and open G to DADGAD, plus your own
• Auto string detection, with a check-off as each string locks in
• Strum to tune: one strum reads every string at once and shows which one to tune first
• Tune by feel: the phone pulses with the beat between your string and its note, slower as they meet and still at the lock, so you can tune without looking
• Studio-lit 3D guitars, basses, violin, cello and mandolin, with the peg to turn shown on the headstock
• Capo, adjustable A4 reference, solfège and sargam note names

LEARN BY PLAYING
• 526 lessons in 11 courses: guitar, ukulele, bass, violin, cello, mandolin, banjo, voice, ear training, music theory and rhythm, plus songbooks for ukulele, mandolin, violin, cello and bass
• Timbre hears every strum: the right chord, on time, and which string didn't ring
• Every note judged as you play it, its pitch to the cent and its timing to the millisecond
• "Show me" plays each new chord on a 3D guitar, the fingers landing in order
• A play-along note highway that slows down for you, then speeds back up as you improve

PLAY SONGS
• 140+ songs, each a full arrangement: classics from Jingle Bells to Amazing Grace, and 50 Originals written for Timbre in today's styles
• Play along with the band in your headphones while the words light up
• Your songs: paste or import any chord chart, transpose it, scroll it in time, and listen to the original on Apple Music beside it

KEEP IT GOING
• Stars, XP, daily quests, streaks and badges
• Apple Watch: a metronome you feel on your wrist, and today's practice at a glance
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, a Live Activity and Siri shortcuts

PRACTICE TOOLS
• Metronome with accents, subdivisions and a speed trainer
• Drone, an intonation trainer, and a chord and scale library
• Ear training: pitch direction, intervals and chord quality, plus a 40-lesson ear course

FREE TO START
Every instrument's standard tuning is free, and guitar, bass, ukulele, violin and cello tune free in every tuning. The first unit of every course and a shelf of songs are free too. Timbre Pro unlocks every lesson and song, every tuning and the full practice set. With notifications on, Timbre reminds you two days before a free trial ends.

Private by design: live microphone audio is analyzed on your device, never recorded or uploaded. No account and no ads.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions.
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://timbre-support.timbre.workers.dev/privacy

Penala percuma, tanpa iklan atau akaun. Kemudian pelajaran yang mendengar anda bermain.

Timbre menggabungkan penala tepat dengan guru muzik. Tala mana-mana daripada 60 alat dalam beberapa saat, kemudian ikuti pelajaran yang mendengar dan menilai permainan anda.

TALA SECARA PERCUMA
• Penalaan standard setiap alat percuma, daripada gitar, ukulele dan violin hingga mandolin, banjo, oud dan erhu.
• Penala kromatik dan strob dengan ketepatan sen. 132 penalaan, daripada Drop D dan Open G hingga DADGAD, serta penalaan anda sendiri.
• Pengesanan tali automatik, dengan tanda semak apabila setiap tali tepat. Satu petikan membaca semua tali dan menunjukkan tali yang perlu ditala dahulu.
• Tala melalui rasa: telefon berdenyut mengikut layangan antara tali dan nada sasaran, semakin perlahan apabila menghampiri lalu berhenti apabila tepat. Tala tanpa melihat.
• Gitar, bes, violin, selo dan mandolin 3D bercahaya studio, dengan pasak yang perlu dipusing ditunjukkan pada kepala alat.
• Kapo, rujukan A4 boleh laras, serta nama not solfa dan sargam.

BELAJAR DENGAN BERMAIN
• 526 pelajaran dalam 11 kursus: gitar, ukulele, bes, violin, selo, mandolin, banjo, vokal, latihan telinga, teori muzik dan irama. Buku lagu untuk ukulele, mandolin, violin, selo dan bes juga tersedia.
• Timbre mendengar setiap petikan: kord yang betul, masanya dan tali yang tidak berbunyi. Setiap not dinilai hingga ke sen dan milisaat.
• “Tunjukkan” memainkan setiap kord baharu pada gitar 3D, dengan jari diletakkan mengikut urutan. Laluan not iringan diperlahankan untuk anda, kemudian dipercepat semula apabila anda semakin mahir.

MAINKAN LAGU
• 140+ lagu dalam susunan lengkap: klasik daripada Jingle Bells hingga Amazing Grace, serta 50 lagu asli yang ditulis untuk Timbre dalam gaya masa kini.
• Main bersama kumpulan muzik melalui fon kepala sementara lirik diserlahkan.
• Lagu anda: tampal atau import carta kord, ubah nada, tatal mengikut masa, dan dengar lagu asal di Apple Music di sebelahnya.

TERUS BERLATIH
• Bintang, XP, misi harian, rentetan dan lencana.
• Game Center: liga Bullseye mingguan, papan kedudukan lagu dan cabaran rakan.
• Apple Watch: metronom yang dirasai pada pergelangan tangan dan latihan hari ini sepintas lalu.
• Widget Skrin Utama dan Skrin Kunci, Aktiviti Langsung dan pintasan Siri.
• Metronom dengan aksen, pembahagian rentak dan latihan kelajuan; nada berterusan, latihan ketepatan nada serta pustaka kord dan skala.
• Latihan telinga: arah pic, selang dan jenis kord, serta kursus telinga 40 pelajaran.

MULA SECARA PERCUMA
Penalaan standard setiap alat percuma. Gitar, bes, ukulele, violin dan selo percuma dalam setiap penalaan. Unit pertama setiap kursus dan pilihan lagu juga percuma. Timbre Pro membuka semua pelajaran, lagu, penalaan dan alat latihan. Dengan pemberitahuan dihidupkan, Timbre mengingatkan anda dua hari sebelum percubaan percuma tamat.

Privasi sejak awal: audio dianalisis pada iPhone anda, tidak pernah dirakam atau dimuat naik. Tiada akaun atau iklan.

Langganan diperbaharui secara automatik melainkan dibatalkan sekurang-kurangnya 24 jam sebelum tempoh berakhir. Urus atau batalkan bila-bila masa melalui Seting → Akaun Apple → Langganan.
Terma: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privasi: <privacy policy URL>

field_changes.old:
Gratis stemapparaat, zonder reclame of account. Daarna lessen die naar je spel luisteren.

Timbre combineert een nauwkeurig stemapparaat met een muziekleraar. Stem elk van 60 instrumenten en leer door te spelen.

GRATIS STEMMEN
De standaardstemming van elk instrument is gratis: gitaar, ukelele, viool, mandoline, banjo, oed, erhu en meer. Chromatisch en stroboscopisch stemmen tot op de cent. 132 stemmingen, van Drop D en Open G tot DADGAD, plus je eigen stemmingen.
Automatische snaarherkenning vinkt elke gestemde snaar af. Eén aanslag leest alle snaren en laat zien welke eerst moet. Voel de stemming: je telefoon pulseert met de zweving tussen snaar en doeltoon, steeds trager tot hij bij de juiste toon stilvalt. Stem zonder te kijken.
3D-gitaren, bassen, viool, cello en mandoline in studiobelichting tonen welke stemknop je draait. Met capo, instelbare A4-referentie, solfège en sargam-notennamen.

LEREN DOOR TE SPELEN
526 lessen in 11 cursussen: gitaar, ukelele, bas, viool, cello, mandoline, banjo, zang, gehoortraining, muziektheorie en ritme. Ook liedboeken voor ukelele, mandoline, viool, cello en bas.
Timbre hoort elke aanslag: het juiste akkoord, op tijd, en welke snaar niet klonk. Elke noot wordt beoordeeld tot op de cent en milliseconde. ‘Laat zien’ speelt nieuwe akkoorden op een 3D-gitaar, met vingers die in volgorde landen. De meespeelbaan vertraagt voor jou en versnelt weer als je beter wordt.

Meer dan 140 nummers, elk met een volledig arrangement: klassiekers van Jingle Bells tot Amazing Grace, waaronder ook 50 Originals in hedendaagse stijlen voor Timbre geschreven. Speel met de band in je koptelefoon terwijl de tekst oplicht. Plak of importeer je eigen akkoordenschema, transponeer het, laat het op tempo scrollen en luister ernaast naar het origineel op Apple Music.

BLIJF SPELEN
Sterren, XP, dagelijkse opdrachten, reeksen en badges. Game Center met een wekelijkse Voltreffer-competitie, ranglijsten voor nummers en vriendenuitdagingen. Apple Watch met voelbare metronoom en je oefendag in één oogopslag. Widgets voor begin- en toegangsscherm, liveactiviteit en Siri-opdrachten.
Metronoom met accenten, onderverdelingen en tempotrainer; bourdon, intonatietrainer en akkoord- en toonladderbibliotheek. Gehoortraining voor toonhoogterichting, intervallen en akkoordsoorten, plus een cursus van 40 lessen.

GRATIS BEGINNEN
Elke standaardstemming is gratis. Gitaar, bas, ukelele, viool en cello zijn in alle stemmingen gratis. De eerste eenheid van elke cursus en een selectie nummers zijn ook gratis. Timbre Pro opent alle lessen, nummers, stemmingen en oefentools. Met meldingen aan herinnert Timbre je twee dagen voor een gratis proefperiode eindigt.
Audio wordt op je iPhone geanalyseerd, nooit opgenomen of geüpload. Geen account, geen reclame.
Abonnementen worden automatisch verlengd tenzij je minstens 24 uur voor het einde opzegt. Beheer of annuleer op elk moment in Instellingen → Apple Account → Abonnementen.
Voorwaarden: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: <privacy policy URL>

field_changes.source:
Free tuner, no ads, no account. Then lessons that listen as you play.

Timbre is a precise tuner and a music teacher in one app. Tune any of 60 instruments in seconds, then play real lessons that listen to you and tell you exactly how you did.

TUNE ANYTHING, FREE
• Every instrument's standard tuning is free, from guitar, ukulele and violin to mandolin, banjo, oud and erhu
• A chromatic and strobe tuner with cent-level precision
• 132 tunings, from drop D and open G to DADGAD, plus your own
• Auto string detection, with a check-off as each string locks in
• Strum to tune: one strum reads every string at once and shows which one to tune first
• Tune by feel: the phone pulses with the beat between your string and its note, slower as they meet and still at the lock, so you can tune without looking
• Studio-lit 3D guitars, basses, violin, cello and mandolin, with the peg to turn shown on the headstock
• Capo, adjustable A4 reference, solfège and sargam note names

LEARN BY PLAYING
• 526 lessons in 11 courses: guitar, ukulele, bass, violin, cello, mandolin, banjo, voice, ear training, music theory and rhythm, plus songbooks for ukulele, mandolin, violin, cello and bass
• Timbre hears every strum: the right chord, on time, and which string didn't ring
• Every note judged as you play it, its pitch to the cent and its timing to the millisecond
• "Show me" plays each new chord on a 3D guitar, the fingers landing in order
• A play-along note highway that slows down for you, then speeds back up as you improve

PLAY SONGS
• 140+ songs, each a full arrangement: classics from Jingle Bells to Amazing Grace, and 50 Originals written for Timbre in today's styles
• Play along with the band in your headphones while the words light up
• Your songs: paste or import any chord chart, transpose it, scroll it in time, and listen to the original on Apple Music beside it

KEEP IT GOING
• Stars, XP, daily quests, streaks and badges
• Apple Watch: a metronome you feel on your wrist, and today's practice at a glance
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, a Live Activity and Siri shortcuts

PRACTICE TOOLS
• Metronome with accents, subdivisions and a speed trainer
• Drone, an intonation trainer, and a chord and scale library
• Ear training: pitch direction, intervals and chord quality, plus a 40-lesson ear course

FREE TO START
Every instrument's standard tuning is free, and guitar, bass, ukulele, violin and cello tune free in every tuning. The first unit of every course and a shelf of songs are free too. Timbre Pro unlocks every lesson and song, every tuning and the full practice set. With notifications on, Timbre reminds you two days before a free trial ends.

Private by design: live microphone audio is analyzed on your device, never recorded or uploaded. No account and no ads.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions.
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://timbre-support.timbre.workers.dev/privacy
field_changes.old:
Gratis stemmeapparat. Ingen reklame, ingen konto. Så leksjoner som lytter når du spiller.

Timbre kombinerer et presist stemmeapparat med en musikklærer. Stem 60 instrumenter og lær ved å spille.

STEM GRATIS
Standardstemmingen til alle instrumenter er gratis: gitar, ukulele, fiolin, mandolin, banjo, oud, erhu og flere. Kromatisk og stroboskopisk stemming med cent-presisjon. 132 stemminger fra Drop D og Open G til DADGAD, pluss dine egne.
Automatisk strenggjenkjenning krysser av hver stemt streng. Ett anslag leser alle strengene og viser hvilken du bør stemme først. Stem med følelsen: mobilen pulserer med svevningen mellom strengen og måltonen, stadig saktere til den stopper når tonen stemmer. Du trenger ikke se.
Studiobelyste 3D-gitarer, basser, fiolin, cello og mandolin viser stemmeskruen du skal vri. Capo, justerbar A4-referanse og solfege- og sargam-notenavn.

LÆR VED Å SPILLE
526 leksjoner i 11 kurs: gitar, ukulele, bass, fiolin, cello, mandolin, banjo, sang, gehør, musikkteori og rytme. I tillegg sangbøker for ukulele, mandolin, fiolin, cello og bass.
Timbre hører hvert anslag: riktig akkord, til riktig tid, og hvilken streng som ikke klang. Hver tone vurderes med cent- og millisekundpresisjon. «Vis meg» spiller nye akkorder på en 3D-gitar med fingrene i rekkefølge. Notebanen senker farten for deg og øker den når du blir bedre.

Over 140 sanger, hver med et komplett arrangement: klassikere fra Jingle Bells til Amazing Grace, inkludert 50 Originals skrevet for Timbre i moderne stiler. Spill med bandet i hodetelefonene mens teksten lyser opp. Lim inn eller importer egne akkordark, transponer, rull i takt og lytt til originalen i Apple Music ved siden av.

FORTSETT Å SPILLE
Stjerner, XP, daglige oppdrag, rekker og merker. Game Center med ukentlig Fulltreff-liga, sangtopplister og venneutfordringer. Apple Watch med metronom du kjenner på håndleddet og oversikt over dagens øving. Widgeter på Hjem- og låseskjermen, direktesendt aktivitet og Siri-snarveier.
Metronom med aksenter, underdelinger og tempotrening; bordun, intonasjonstrening og akkord- og skalabibliotek. Gehør: tonehøyderetning, intervaller og akkordtyper, pluss et kurs med 40 leksjoner.

START GRATIS
Alle standardstemminger er gratis. Gitar, bass, ukulele, fiolin og cello er gratis i alle stemminger. Første enhet i hvert kurs og et utvalg sanger er også gratis. Timbre Pro åpner alle leksjoner, sanger, stemminger og øvingsverktøy. Med varslinger på minner Timbre deg på det to dager før en gratis prøveperiode utløper.
Lyd analyseres på iPhone, blir aldri tatt opp eller lastet opp. Ingen konto, ingen reklame.
Abonnementer fornyes automatisk hvis de ikke sies opp minst 24 timer før perioden utløper. Administrer eller avslutt når som helst i Innstillinger → Apple-konto → Abonnementer.
Vilkår: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Personvern: <privacy policy URL>

ମାଗଣା ଟ୍ୟୁନର। ବିଜ୍ଞାପନ କିମ୍ବା ଖାତା ଦରକାର ନାହିଁ। ତା’ପରେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବାଦନ ଶୁଣୁଥିବା ପାଠ।

Timbreରେ ସଠିକ୍ ଟ୍ୟୁନର ଓ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ଶିକ୍ଷକ ଏକାଠି। 60 ବାଦ୍ୟ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଯେକୌଣସିଟିକୁ କିଛି ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ ଟ୍ୟୁନ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତା’ପରେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବାଦନ ଶୁଣି ସଠିକ୍ ମତାମତ ଦେଉଥିବା ପାଠରେ ଶିଖନ୍ତୁ।

ମାଗଣାରେ ଟ୍ୟୁନ କରନ୍ତୁ
• ଗିଟାର, ୟୁକୁଲେଲେ ଓ ବାୟୋଲିନଠାରୁ ମାଣ୍ଡୋଲିନ, ବାଞ୍ଜୋ, ଊଦ୍ ଓ ଏରହୁ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ବାଦ୍ୟର ମାନକ ଟ୍ୟୁନିଂ ମାଗଣା।
• ସେଣ୍ଟ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସଠିକ୍ କ୍ରୋମାଟିକ ଓ ଷ୍ଟ୍ରୋବ୍ ଟ୍ୟୁନର। Drop D, Open G ଓ DADGAD ସମେତ 132 ଟ୍ୟୁନିଂ, ନିଜର ଟ୍ୟୁନିଂ ମଧ୍ୟ ତିଆରି କରନ୍ତୁ।
• ତାରର ସ୍ୱୟଂଚାଳିତ ଚିହ୍ନଟ ଓ ସୁର ମିଳିଲେ ଠିକ୍ ଚିହ୍ନ। ଥରେ ଷ୍ଟ୍ରମ୍ କଲେ ସବୁ ତାର ପଢ଼ି ପ୍ରଥମେ କେଉଁଟି ଟ୍ୟୁନ କରିବେ ଦେଖାଏ।
• ଅନୁଭବ କରି ଟ୍ୟୁନ କରନ୍ତୁ: ତାର ଓ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ସ୍ୱର ମଧ୍ୟର ସ୍ପନ୍ଦନ ସହ ଫୋନ୍ କମ୍ପେ; ସ୍ୱର ନିକଟତର ହେଲେ ଧୀର ହୁଏ ଓ ମିଳିଲେ ଥାମେ। ନ ଦେଖି ଟ୍ୟୁନ କରିପାରିବେ।
• ଷ୍ଟୁଡିଓ ଆଲୋକରେ 3D ଗିଟାର, ବେସ୍, ବାୟୋଲିନ, ସେଲୋ ଓ ମାଣ୍ଡୋଲିନ; ହେଡଷ୍ଟକ୍‌ରେ ଘୁରାଇବା ଖୁଣ୍ଟି ଦେଖାଏ।
• କାପୋ, ବଦଳାଯାଇପାରୁଥିବା A4 ସନ୍ଦର୍ଭ, ସୋଲଫେଜ୍ ଓ ସରଗମ୍ ସ୍ୱରନାମ।

ବଜାଇ ଶିଖନ୍ତୁ
• 11 ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମରେ 526 ପାଠ: ଗିଟାର, ୟୁକୁଲେଲେ, ବେସ୍, ବାୟୋଲିନ, ସେଲୋ, ମାଣ୍ଡୋଲିନ, ବାଞ୍ଜୋ, ଗାୟନ, ଶ୍ରବଣ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ, ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ତତ୍ତ୍ୱ ଓ ତାଳ। ୟୁକୁଲେଲେ, ମାଣ୍ଡୋଲିନ, ବାୟୋଲିନ, ସେଲୋ ଓ ବେସ୍ ପାଇଁ ଗୀତପୁସ୍ତକ ମଧ୍ୟ।
• Timbre ପ୍ରତି ଷ୍ଟ୍ରମ୍ ଶୁଣେ: ସଠିକ୍ କର୍ଡ, ସମୟ ଓ କେଉଁ ତାର ବାଜିଲା ନାହିଁ। ପ୍ରତି ସ୍ୱରର ଉଚ୍ଚତା ସେଣ୍ଟ ଓ ସମୟ ମିଲିସେକେଣ୍ଡ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ମୂଲ୍ୟାୟନ ହୁଏ।
• “ମୋତେ ଦେଖାନ୍ତୁ” ନୂଆ କର୍ଡକୁ 3D ଗିଟାରରେ ବଜାଏ, ଆଙ୍ଗୁଳି କ୍ରମରେ ବସେ। ସାଙ୍ଗରେ ବଜାଇବା ସ୍ୱରପଥ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଧୀର ହୁଏ ଓ ଉନ୍ନତି ସହ ପୁଣି ଦ୍ରୁତ ହୁଏ।

ଗୀତ ବଜାନ୍ତୁ
• 140+ ଗୀତ, ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକର ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ଆୟୋଜନ: Jingle Bellsରୁ Amazing Grace ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ପୁରୁଣା ଲୋକପ୍ରିୟ ଗୀତ ଓ ଆଜିର ଶୈଳୀରେ Timbre ପାଇଁ ଲେଖା 50 ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ।

• ତାରକା, XP, ଦୈନିକ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ, ଲଗାତାର ଦିନ ଓ ବ୍ୟାଜ୍।

field_changes.source:
Free tuner, no ads, no account. Then lessons that listen as you play.

Timbre is a precise tuner and a music teacher in one app. Tune any of 60 instruments in seconds, then play real lessons that listen to you and tell you exactly how you did.

TUNE ANYTHING, FREE
• Every instrument's standard tuning is free, from guitar, ukulele and violin to mandolin, banjo, oud and erhu
• A chromatic and strobe tuner with cent-level precision
• 132 tunings, from drop D and open G to DADGAD, plus your own
• Auto string detection, with a check-off as each string locks in
• Strum to tune: one strum reads every string at once and shows which one to tune first
• Tune by feel: the phone pulses with the beat between your string and its note, slower as they meet and still at the lock, so you can tune without looking
• Studio-lit 3D guitars, basses, violin, cello and mandolin, with the peg to turn shown on the headstock
• Capo, adjustable A4 reference, solfège and sargam note names

LEARN BY PLAYING
• 526 lessons in 11 courses: guitar, ukulele, bass, violin, cello, mandolin, banjo, voice, ear training, music theory and rhythm, plus songbooks for ukulele, mandolin, violin, cello and bass
• Timbre hears every strum: the right chord, on time, and which string didn't ring
• Every note judged as you play it, its pitch to the cent and its timing to the millisecond
• "Show me" plays each new chord on a 3D guitar, the fingers landing in order
• A play-along note highway that slows down for you, then speeds back up as you improve

PLAY SONGS
• 140+ songs, each a full arrangement: classics from Jingle Bells to Amazing Grace, and 50 Originals written for Timbre in today's styles
• Play along with the band in your headphones while the words light up
• Your songs: paste or import any chord chart, transpose it, scroll it in time, and listen to the original on Apple Music beside it

KEEP IT GOING
• Stars, XP, daily quests, streaks and badges
• Apple Watch: a metronome you feel on your wrist, and today's practice at a glance
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, a Live Activity and Siri shortcuts

PRACTICE TOOLS
• Metronome with accents, subdivisions and a speed trainer
• Drone, an intonation trainer, and a chord and scale library
• Ear training: pitch direction, intervals and chord quality, plus a 40-lesson ear course

FREE TO START
Every instrument's standard tuning is free, and guitar, bass, ukulele, violin and cello tune free in every tuning. The first unit of every course and a shelf of songs are free too. Timbre Pro unlocks every lesson and song, every tuning and the full practice set. With notifications on, Timbre reminds you two days before a free trial ends.

Private by design: live microphone audio is analyzed on your device, never recorded or uploaded. No account and no ads.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions.

ਮੁਫ਼ਤ ਟਿਊਨਰ, ਨਾ ਇਸ਼ਤਿਹਾਰ ਨਾ ਖਾਤਾ। ਫਿਰ ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਵਜਾਉਣਾ ਸੁਣਦੇ ਪਾਠ।

Timbre ਵਿੱਚ ਸਟੀਕ ਟਿਊਨਰ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਗੀਤ ਅਧਿਆਪਕ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਹਨ। 60 ਸਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕੋਈ ਵੀ ਸਕਿੰਟਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਟਿਊਨ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਸੁਣ ਕੇ ਸਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਕਿਰਿਆ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਪਾਠਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਜਾਓ।

ਮੁਫ਼ਤ ਟਿਊਨਿੰਗ
• ਗਿਟਾਰ, ਯੂਕੁਲੇਲੇ ਅਤੇ ਵਾਇਲਿਨ ਤੋਂ ਮੈਂਡੋਲਿਨ, ਬੈਂਜੋ, ਊਦ ਅਤੇ ਏਰਹੂ ਤੱਕ ਹਰ ਸਾਜ਼ ਦੀ ਮਿਆਰੀ ਟਿਊਨਿੰਗ ਮੁਫ਼ਤ ਹੈ।
• ਸੈਂਟ ਤੱਕ ਸਟੀਕ ਕ੍ਰੋਮੈਟਿਕ ਅਤੇ ਸਟ੍ਰੋਬ ਟਿਊਨਰ। Drop D, Open G ਅਤੇ DADGAD ਸਮੇਤ 132 ਟਿਊਨਿੰਗ, ਨਾਲ ਆਪਣੀ ਟਿਊਨਿੰਗ ਵੀ ਬਣਾਓ।
• ਤਾਰ ਦੀ ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਪਛਾਣ ਅਤੇ ਸੁਰ ਮਿਲਣ 'ਤੇ ਸਹੀ ਦਾ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨ। ਇੱਕ ਸਟ੍ਰਮ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਤਾਰਾਂ ਪੜ੍ਹਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਟਿਊਨ ਕਰਨੀ ਹੈ।
• ਮਹਿਸੂਸ ਕਰਕੇ ਟਿਊਨ ਕਰੋ: ਤਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨੇ ਦੇ ਸੁਰ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਧੜਕਣ ਨਾਲ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਕੰਬਦਾ ਹੈ, ਸੁਰ ਨੇੜੇ ਆਉਣ 'ਤੇ ਹੌਲੀ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਤੇ ਮਿਲਣ 'ਤੇ ਰੁਕ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਬਿਨਾਂ ਵੇਖੇ ਟਿਊਨ ਕਰੋ।
• ਸਟੂਡੀਓ ਰੋਸ਼ਨੀ ਵਾਲੇ 3D ਗਿਟਾਰ, ਬੇਸ, ਵਾਇਲਿਨ, ਸੈਲੋ ਅਤੇ ਮੈਂਡੋਲਿਨ; ਹੈੱਡਸਟੌਕ 'ਤੇ ਘੁਮਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਖੂੰਟੀ ਦਿਸਦੀ ਹੈ।
• ਕੈਪੋ, ਬਦਲਣਯੋਗ A4 ਹਵਾਲਾ, ਸੋਲਫੇਜ ਅਤੇ ਸਰਗਮ ਦੇ ਸੁਰ-ਨਾਮ।

ਵਜਾ ਕੇ ਸਿੱਖੋ
• 11 ਕੋਰਸਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ 526 ਪਾਠ: ਗਿਟਾਰ, ਯੂਕੁਲੇਲੇ, ਬੇਸ, ਵਾਇਲਿਨ, ਸੈਲੋ, ਮੈਂਡੋਲਿਨ, ਬੈਂਜੋ, ਗਾਇਨ, ਸੁਣਨ ਅਭਿਆਸ, ਸੰਗੀਤ ਸਿਧਾਂਤ ਅਤੇ ਲੈਅ। ਯੂਕੁਲੇਲੇ, ਮੈਂਡੋਲਿਨ, ਵਾਇਲਿਨ, ਸੈਲੋ ਅਤੇ ਬੇਸ ਦੀਆਂ ਗੀਤ-ਪੁਸਤਕਾਂ ਵੀ।
• Timbre ਹਰ ਸਟ੍ਰਮ ਸੁਣਦਾ ਹੈ: ਸਹੀ ਕੋਰਡ, ਸਮਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਤਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਵੱਜੀ। ਹਰ ਸੁਰ ਦੀ ਉਚਾਈ ਸੈਂਟ ਤੱਕ ਅਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ ਮਿਲੀਸਕਿੰਟ ਤੱਕ ਜਾਂਚਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
• “ਦਿਖਾਓ” ਹਰ ਨਵਾਂ ਕੋਰਡ 3D ਗਿਟਾਰ 'ਤੇ ਵਜਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ; ਉਂਗਲਾਂ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਲੱਗਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਨਾਲ ਵਜਾਉਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਸੁਰ-ਮਾਰਗ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਲਈ ਹੌਲੀ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਅਤੇ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਨਾਲ ਤੇਜ਼ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ।

ਗੀਤ ਵਜਾਓ
• 140+ ਗੀਤ, ਹਰੇਕ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਅਰੇਂਜਮੈਂਟ: Jingle Bells ਤੋਂ Amazing Grace ਤੱਕ ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਮਸ਼ਹੂਰ ਗੀਤ ਅਤੇ ਅੱਜ ਦੀਆਂ ਸ਼ੈਲੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ Timbre ਲਈ ਲਿਖੇ 50 ਮੌਲਿਕ ਗੀਤ।
• ਹੈੱਡਫ਼ੋਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੈਂਡ ਨਾਲ ਵਜਾਓ, ਸ਼ਬਦ ਚਮਕਦੇ ਹਨ।
• ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਗੀਤ: ਕੋਰਡ ਚਾਰਟ ਪੇਸਟ ਜਾਂ ਆਯਾਤ ਕਰੋ, ਸੁਰ ਬਦਲੋ, ਸਮੇਂ ਨਾਲ ਸਕ੍ਰੋਲ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਨਾਲ Apple Music 'ਤੇ ਅਸਲ ਗੀਤ ਸੁਣੋ।

ਅਭਿਆਸ ਜਾਰੀ ਰੱਖੋ
• ਤਾਰੇ, XP, ਰੋਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਮੁਹਿੰਮਾਂ, ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਦਿਨ ਅਤੇ ਬੈਜ।
• Game Center: ਹਫ਼ਤਾਵਾਰੀ ਸਟੀਕ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨਾ ਲੀਗ, ਗੀਤ ਲੀਡਰਬੋਰਡ ਅਤੇ ਦੋਸਤਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਚੁਣੌਤੀਆਂ।
• Apple Watch: ਗੁੱਟ 'ਤੇ ਮਹਿਸੂਸ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਮੈਟਰੋਨੋਮ ਅਤੇ ਅੱਜ ਦਾ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਇੱਕ ਨਜ਼ਰ ਵਿੱਚ।
• ਹੋਮ ਅਤੇ ਲੌਕ ਸਕ੍ਰੀਨ ਵਿਜੇਟ, ਲਾਈਵ ਐਕਟੀਵਿਟੀ ਅਤੇ Siri ਸ਼ਾਰਟਕੱਟ।
• ਜ਼ੋਰ, ਉਪ-ਵੰਡਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਰਫ਼ਤਾਰ ਸਿਖਲਾਈ ਵਾਲਾ ਮੈਟਰੋਨੋਮ; ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਸੁਰ, ਸੁਰ-ਸ਼ੁੱਧਤਾ ਸਿਖਲਾਈ, ਕੋਰਡ ਅਤੇ ਸਕੇਲ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿ।
• ਸੁਣਨ ਅਭਿਆਸ: ਸੁਰ ਦੀ ਦਿਸ਼ਾ, ਅੰਤਰਾਲ ਅਤੇ ਕੋਰਡ ਕਿਸਮਾਂ; 40 ਪਾਠਾਂ ਦਾ ਸੁਣਨ ਕੋਰਸ ਵੀ।

ਮੁਫ਼ਤ ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤ
ਹਰ ਸਾਜ਼ ਦੀ ਮਿਆਰੀ ਟਿਊਨਿੰਗ ਮੁਫ਼ਤ ਹੈ। ਗਿਟਾਰ, ਬੇਸ, ਯੂਕੁਲੇਲੇ, ਵਾਇਲਿਨ ਅਤੇ ਸੈਲੋ ਦੀ ਹਰ ਟਿਊਨਿੰਗ ਮੁਫ਼ਤ ਹੈ। ਹਰ ਕੋਰਸ ਦੀ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਇਕਾਈ ਅਤੇ ਕੁਝ ਗੀਤ ਵੀ ਮੁਫ਼ਤ ਹਨ। Timbre Pro ਸਾਰੇ ਪਾਠ, ਗੀਤ, ਟਿਊਨਿੰਗ ਅਤੇ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਸੰਦ ਖੋਲ੍ਹਦਾ ਹੈ। ਸੂਚਨਾਵਾਂ ਚਾਲੂ ਹੋਣ 'ਤੇ Timbre ਮੁਫ਼ਤ ਟ੍ਰਾਇਲ ਖ਼ਤਮ ਹੋਣ ਤੋਂ ਦੋ ਦਿਨ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਯਾਦ ਕਰਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

ਨਿੱਜਤਾ ਮੂਲ ਵਿੱਚ: ਆਡੀਓ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ iPhone 'ਤੇ ਜਾਂਚਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ; ਕਦੇ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਜਾਂ ਅੱਪਲੋਡ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ। ਨਾ ਖਾਤਾ, ਨਾ ਇਸ਼ਤਿਹਾਰ।

ਮਿਆਦ ਖ਼ਤਮ ਹੋਣ ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ 24 ਘੰਟੇ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਰੱਦ ਨਾ ਕਰਨ 'ਤੇ ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨ ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਨਵੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ। ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ → Apple ਖਾਤਾ → ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਦੇ ਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧ ਜਾਂ ਰੱਦ ਕਰੋ।

• 11 ਕੋਰਸਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ 526 ਪਾਠ: ਗਿਟਾਰ, ਯੂਕੁਲੇਲੇ, ਬੇਸ, ਵਾਇਲਿਨ, ਸੈਲੋ, ਮੈਂਡੋਲਿਨ, ਬੈਂਜੋ, ਗਾਇਨ, ਸੁਣਨ ਅਭਿਆਸ, ਸੰਗੀਤ ਸਿਧਾਂਤ ਅਤੇ ਲੈਅ। ਯੂਕੁਲੇਲੇ, ਮੈਂਡੋਲਿਨ, ਵਾਇਲਿਨ, ਸੈਲੋ ਅਤੇ ਬੇਸ ਦੀਆਂ ਗੀਤ-ਪੁਸਤਕਾਂ ਵੀ।
• Timbre ਹਰ ਸਟ੍ਰਮ ਸੁਣਦਾ ਹੈ: ਸਹੀ ਕੋਰਡ, ਸਮਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਤਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਵੱਜੀ। ਹਰ ਸੁਰ ਦੀ ਉਚਾਈ ਸੈਂਟ ਤੱਕ ਅਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ ਮਿਲੀਸਕਿੰਟ ਤੱਕ ਜਾਂਚਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
• “ਦਿਖਾਓ” ਹਰ ਨਵਾਂ ਕੋਰਡ 3D ਗਿਟਾਰ 'ਤੇ ਵਜਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ; ਉਂਗਲਾਂ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਲੱਗਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਨਾਲ ਵਜਾਉਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਸੁਰ-ਮਾਰਗ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਲਈ ਹੌਲੀ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਅਤੇ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਨਾਲ ਤੇਜ਼ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ।

ਗੀਤ ਵਜਾਓ
• 140+ ਗੀਤ, ਹਰੇਕ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਅਰੇਂਜਮੈਂਟ: Jingle Bells ਤੋਂ Amazing Grace ਤੱਕ ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਮਸ਼ਹੂਰ ਗੀਤ ਅਤੇ ਅੱਜ ਦੀਆਂ ਸ਼ੈਲੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ Timbre ਲਈ ਲਿਖੇ 50 ਮੌਲਿਕ ਗੀਤ।
• ਹੈੱਡਫ਼ੋਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੈਂਡ ਨਾਲ ਵਜਾਓ, ਸ਼ਬਦ ਚਮਕਦੇ ਹਨ।
• ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਗੀਤ: ਕੋਰਡ ਚਾਰਟ ਪੇਸਟ ਜਾਂ ਆਯਾਤ ਕਰੋ, ਸੁਰ ਬਦਲੋ, ਸਮੇਂ ਨਾਲ ਸਕ੍ਰੋਲ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਨਾਲ Apple Music 'ਤੇ ਅਸਲ ਗੀਤ ਸੁਣੋ।

ਅਭਿਆਸ ਜਾਰੀ ਰੱਖੋ
• ਤਾਰੇ, XP, ਰੋਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਮੁਹਿੰਮਾਂ, ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਦਿਨ ਅਤੇ ਬੈਜ।
• Apple Watch: ਗੁੱਟ 'ਤੇ ਮਹਿਸੂਸ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਮੈਟਰੋਨੋਮ ਅਤੇ ਅੱਜ ਦਾ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਇੱਕ ਨਜ਼ਰ ਵਿੱਚ।
• ਹੋਮ ਅਤੇ ਲੌਕ ਸਕ੍ਰੀਨ ਵਿਜੇਟ, ਲਾਈਵ ਐਕਟੀਵਿਟੀ ਅਤੇ Siri ਸ਼ਾਰਟਕੱਟ।
• ਜ਼ੋਰ, ਉਪ-ਵੰਡਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਰਫ਼ਤਾਰ ਸਿਖਲਾਈ ਵਾਲਾ ਮੈਟਰੋਨੋਮ; ਲਗਾਤਾਰ ਸੁਰ, ਸੁਰ-ਸ਼ੁੱਧਤਾ ਸਿਖਲਾਈ, ਕੋਰਡ ਅਤੇ ਸਕੇਲ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿ।
• ਸੁਣਨ ਅਭਿਆਸ: ਸੁਰ ਦੀ ਦਿਸ਼ਾ, ਅੰਤਰਾਲ ਅਤੇ ਕੋਰਡ ਕਿਸਮਾਂ; 40 ਪਾਠਾਂ ਦਾ ਸੁਣਨ ਕੋਰਸ ਵੀ।

ਮੁਫ਼ਤ ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤ
ਹਰ ਸਾਜ਼ ਦੀ ਮਿਆਰੀ ਟਿਊਨਿੰਗ ਮੁਫ਼ਤ ਹੈ। ਗਿਟਾਰ, ਬੇਸ, ਯੂਕੁਲੇਲੇ, ਵਾਇਲਿਨ ਅਤੇ ਸੈਲੋ ਦੀ ਹਰ ਟਿਊਨਿੰਗ ਮੁਫ਼ਤ ਹੈ। ਹਰ ਕੋਰਸ ਦੀ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਇਕਾਈ ਅਤੇ ਕੁਝ ਗੀਤ ਵੀ ਮੁਫ਼ਤ ਹਨ। Timbre Pro ਸਾਰੇ ਪਾਠ, ਗੀਤ, ਟਿਊਨਿੰਗ ਅਤੇ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਸੰਦ ਖੋਲ੍ਹਦਾ ਹੈ। ਸੂਚਨਾਵਾਂ ਚਾਲੂ ਹੋਣ 'ਤੇ Timbre ਮੁਫ਼ਤ ਟ੍ਰਾਇਲ ਖ਼ਤਮ ਹੋਣ ਤੋਂ ਦੋ ਦਿਨ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਯਾਦ ਕਰਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

ਨਿੱਜਤਾ ਮੂਲ ਵਿੱਚ: ਮਾਈਕ੍ਰੋਫ਼ੋਨ ਤੋਂ ਆਉਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਆਡੀਓ ਦਾ ਉਸੇ ਵੇਲੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ਉੱਤੇ ਵਿਸ਼ਲੇਸ਼ਣ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ; ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਕਦੇ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਜਾਂ ਅੱਪਲੋਡ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ। ਨਾ ਖਾਤਾ, ਨਾ ਇਸ਼ਤਿਹਾਰ।

ਮਿਆਦ ਖ਼ਤਮ ਹੋਣ ਤੋਂ ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ 24 ਘੰਟੇ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਰੱਦ ਨਾ ਕਰਨ 'ਤੇ ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨ ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਨਵੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ। ਸੈਟਿੰਗਾਂ → Apple ਖਾਤਾ → ਸਬਸਕ੍ਰਿਪਸ਼ਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਦੇ ਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧ ਜਾਂ ਰੱਦ ਕਰੋ।

field_changes.source:
Free tuner, no ads, no account. Then lessons that listen as you play.

Timbre is a precise tuner and a music teacher in one app. Tune any of 60 instruments in seconds, then play real lessons that listen to you and tell you exactly how you did.

TUNE ANYTHING, FREE
• Every instrument's standard tuning is free, from guitar, ukulele and violin to mandolin, banjo, oud and erhu
• A chromatic and strobe tuner with cent-level precision
• 132 tunings, from drop D and open G to DADGAD, plus your own
• Auto string detection, with a check-off as each string locks in
• Strum to tune: one strum reads every string at once and shows which one to tune first
• Tune by feel: the phone pulses with the beat between your string and its note, slower as they meet and still at the lock, so you can tune without looking
• Studio-lit 3D guitars, basses, violin, cello and mandolin, with the peg to turn shown on the headstock
• Capo, adjustable A4 reference, solfège and sargam note names

LEARN BY PLAYING
• 526 lessons in 11 courses: guitar, ukulele, bass, violin, cello, mandolin, banjo, voice, ear training, music theory and rhythm, plus songbooks for ukulele, mandolin, violin, cello and bass
• Timbre hears every strum: the right chord, on time, and which string didn't ring
• Every note judged as you play it, its pitch to the cent and its timing to the millisecond
• "Show me" plays each new chord on a 3D guitar, the fingers landing in order
• A play-along note highway that slows down for you, then speeds back up as you improve

PLAY SONGS
• 140+ songs, each a full arrangement: classics from Jingle Bells to Amazing Grace, and 50 Originals written for Timbre in today's styles
• Play along with the band in your headphones while the words light up
• Your songs: paste or import any chord chart, transpose it, scroll it in time, and listen to the original on Apple Music beside it

KEEP IT GOING
• Stars, XP, daily quests, streaks and badges
• Apple Watch: a metronome you feel on your wrist, and today's practice at a glance
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, a Live Activity and Siri shortcuts

PRACTICE TOOLS
• Metronome with accents, subdivisions and a speed trainer
• Drone, an intonation trainer, and a chord and scale library
• Ear training: pitch direction, intervals and chord quality, plus a 40-lesson ear course

FREE TO START
Every instrument's standard tuning is free, and guitar, bass, ukulele, violin and cello tune free in every tuning. The first unit of every course and a shelf of songs are free too. Timbre Pro unlocks every lesson and song, every tuning and the full practice set. With notifications on, Timbre reminds you two days before a free trial ends.

Private by design: live microphone audio is analyzed on your device, never recorded or uploaded. No account and no ads.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions.

Darmowy stroik. Bez reklam i konta. Potem lekcje, które słuchają Twojej gry.

Timbre łączy precyzyjny stroik i nauczyciela muzyki. Nastrój 60 instrumentów i ucz się grając.

STRÓJ ZA DARMO
Standardowy strój każdego instrumentu jest darmowy: gitara, ukulele, skrzypce, mandolina, banjo, oud, erhu i inne. Stroik chromatyczny i stroboskopowy z dokładnością do centa. 132 stroje, od Drop D i Open G po DADGAD, oraz własne.
Automatyczne rozpoznawanie strun zaznacza każdą nastrojoną. Jedno uderzenie odczytuje wszystkie i pokazuje, którą nastroić najpierw. Strojenie dotykiem: telefon pulsuje w rytmie dudnień między struną a dźwiękiem docelowym, coraz wolniej, aż zatrzyma się przy zestrojeniu. Nie musisz patrzeć.
Gitary, basy, skrzypce, wiolonczela i mandolina 3D w studyjnym świetle pokazują kołek do obrócenia. Kapodaster, regulowany wzorzec A4, nazwy dźwięków solfeżu i sargam.

UCZ SIĘ GRAJĄC
526 lekcji w 11 kursach: gitara, ukulele, bas, skrzypce, wiolonczela, mandolina, banjo, śpiew, słuch, teoria muzyki i rytm. Także śpiewniki na ukulele, mandolinę, skrzypce, wiolonczelę i bas.
Timbre słyszy każde uderzenie: właściwy akord, rytm i strunę, która nie zabrzmiała. Każda nuta jest oceniana z dokładnością do centa i milisekundy. „Pokaż mi” gra nowe akordy na gitarze 3D, ustawiając palce po kolei. Tor nut zwalnia dla Ciebie i przyspiesza wraz z postępami.

Ponad 140 piosenek, każda z pełną aranżacją: klasyka od Jingle Bells do Amazing Grace, w tym również 50 Originals napisanych dla Timbre we współczesnych stylach. Graj z zespołem w słuchawkach, gdy słowa się podświetlają. Wklej lub zaimportuj własny zapis akordów, transponuj, przewijaj w rytmie i słuchaj obok oryginału w Apple Music.

GRAJ DALEJ
Gwiazdki, XP, codzienne zadania, serie i odznaki. Game Center: cotygodniowa liga Dziesiątka, rankingi piosenek i wyzwania znajomych. Apple Watch: metronom odczuwalny na nadgarstku i dzisiejsze ćwiczenia w skrócie. Widżety ekranu początkowego i blokady, aktywność na żywo i skróty Siri.
Metronom z akcentami, podziałami i treningiem tempa; burdon, trening intonacji oraz biblioteka akordów i skal. Kształcenie słuchu: kierunek wysokości, interwały i rodzaje akordów, a także kurs 40 lekcji.

ZACZNIJ ZA DARMO
Standardowe stroje wszystkich instrumentów są darmowe. Gitara, bas, ukulele, skrzypce i wiolonczela są darmowe we wszystkich strojach. Pierwszy dział każdego kursu i wybór piosenek też są darmowe. Timbre Pro odblokowuje wszystkie lekcje, piosenki, stroje i narzędzia ćwiczeń. Przy włączonych powiadomieniach Timbre przypomina dwa dni przed końcem bezpłatnego okresu próbnego.
Dźwięk jest analizowany na iPhonie, nigdy nagrywany ani przesyłany. Bez konta i reklam.
Subskrypcje odnawiają się automatycznie, jeśli nie anulujesz ich co najmniej 24 godziny przed końcem okresu. Zarządzaj lub anuluj w dowolnej chwili: Ustawienia → Konto Apple → Subskrypcje.
Warunki: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Prywatność: <privacy policy URL>

field_changes.source:
Free tuner, no ads, no account. Then lessons that listen as you play.

Timbre is a precise tuner and a music teacher in one app. Tune any of 60 instruments in seconds, then play real lessons that listen to you and tell you exactly how you did.

TUNE ANYTHING, FREE
• Every instrument's standard tuning is free, from guitar, ukulele and violin to mandolin, banjo, oud and erhu
• A chromatic and strobe tuner with cent-level precision
• 132 tunings, from drop D and open G to DADGAD, plus your own
• Auto string detection, with a check-off as each string locks in
• Strum to tune: one strum reads every string at once and shows which one to tune first
• Tune by feel: the phone pulses with the beat between your string and its note, slower as they meet and still at the lock, so you can tune without looking
• Studio-lit 3D guitars, basses, violin, cello and mandolin, with the peg to turn shown on the headstock
• Capo, adjustable A4 reference, solfège and sargam note names

LEARN BY PLAYING
• 526 lessons in 11 courses: guitar, ukulele, bass, violin, cello, mandolin, banjo, voice, ear training, music theory and rhythm, plus songbooks for ukulele, mandolin, violin, cello and bass
• Timbre hears every strum: the right chord, on time, and which string didn't ring
• Every note judged as you play it, its pitch to the cent and its timing to the millisecond
• "Show me" plays each new chord on a 3D guitar, the fingers landing in order
• A play-along note highway that slows down for you, then speeds back up as you improve

PLAY SONGS
• 140+ songs, each a full arrangement: classics from Jingle Bells to Amazing Grace, and 50 Originals written for Timbre in today's styles
• Play along with the band in your headphones while the words light up
• Your songs: paste or import any chord chart, transpose it, scroll it in time, and listen to the original on Apple Music beside it

KEEP IT GOING
• Stars, XP, daily quests, streaks and badges
• Apple Watch: a metronome you feel on your wrist, and today's practice at a glance
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, a Live Activity and Siri shortcuts

PRACTICE TOOLS
• Metronome with accents, subdivisions and a speed trainer
• Drone, an intonation trainer, and a chord and scale library
• Ear training: pitch direction, intervals and chord quality, plus a 40-lesson ear course

FREE TO START
Every instrument's standard tuning is free, and guitar, bass, ukulele, violin and cello tune free in every tuning. The first unit of every course and a shelf of songs are free too. Timbre Pro unlocks every lesson and song, every tuning and the full practice set. With notifications on, Timbre reminds you two days before a free trial ends.

Private by design: live microphone audio is analyzed on your device, never recorded or uploaded. No account and no ads.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions.

field_changes.old:
Afinador grátis, sem anúncios nem conta. Depois, aulas que ouvem você tocar.

Timbre reúne um afinador preciso e um professor de música. Afine 60 instrumentos e saiba exatamente como foi sua execução.

AFINE DE GRAÇA
• A afinação padrão de cada instrumento é grátis: violão, ukulele, violino, bandolim, banjo, oud, erhu e mais.
• Afinador cromático e estroboscópico com precisão em cents; 132 afinações, de Drop D e Open G a DADGAD, além das suas.
• Detecção automática de cordas, com marcação ao afinar cada uma. Uma batida lê todas as cordas e indica qual afinar primeiro.
• Afine pelo tato: o celular pulsa com o batimento entre a corda e a nota, desacelera quando se aproximam e para ao afinar. Assim, você afina sem olhar.
• Violões, baixos, violino, violoncelo e bandolim em 3D com iluminação de estúdio e indicação da tarraxa a girar.
• Capotraste, referência A4 ajustável e nomes de notas em solfejo e sargam.

APRENDA TOCANDO
• 526 aulas em 11 cursos: violão, ukulele, baixo, violino, violoncelo, bandolim, banjo, canto, percepção musical, teoria e ritmo. Mais cancioneiros para ukulele, bandolim, violino, violoncelo e baixo.
• Timbre ouve cada batida: o acorde certo, no tempo e qual corda não soou. Cada nota é avaliada em cents e milissegundos enquanto você toca.
• “Mostre-me” toca cada novo acorde em um violão 3D, com os dedos pousando em ordem. A pista de notas desacelera para você e volta a acelerar conforme você melhora.

TOQUE MÚSICAS
• Mais de 140 músicas com arranjos completos: clássicos de Jingle Bells a Amazing Grace e 50 Originals escritos para Timbre em estilos atuais.
• Toque com a banda nos fones enquanto a letra se ilumina.
• Suas músicas: cole ou importe uma cifra, transponha, role no ritmo e ouça o original ao lado no Apple Music.

MANTENHA O RITMO
• Estrelas, XP, missões diárias, sequências e conquistas.
• Game Center: liga semanal de Na mosca, classificações de músicas e desafios entre amigos.
• Apple Watch: metrônomo que você sente no pulso e resumo da prática de hoje.
• Widgets na Tela de Início e Bloqueada, Atividade ao Vivo e atalhos da Siri.
• Metrônomo com acentos, subdivisões e treino de velocidade; nota pedal, treino de afinação e biblioteca de acordes e escalas.
• Percepção musical: direção da altura, intervalos e tipos de acordes, além de um curso de 40 aulas.

COMECE GRÁTIS
A afinação padrão de todo instrumento é grátis; violão, baixo, ukulele, violino e violoncelo são grátis em todas as afinações. A primeira unidade de cada curso e uma seleção de músicas também são grátis. Timbre Pro libera todas as aulas, músicas, afinações e ferramentas de prática. Com as notificações ativadas, Timbre avisa dois dias antes do fim de um teste grátis.

Privacidade desde o início: o áudio é analisado no iPhone, nunca gravado nem enviado. Sem conta nem anúncios.

Assinaturas são renovadas automaticamente, a menos que sejam canceladas pelo menos 24 horas antes do fim do período. Gerencie ou cancele a qualquer momento em Ajustes → Conta Apple → Assinaturas.
Termos: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacidade: <privacy policy URL>

• A afinação padrão de cada instrumento é grátis: da guitarra, ukulele e violino ao bandolim, banjo, oud e erhu.
• Afinador cromático e estroboscópico com precisão ao cent. 132 afinações, de Drop D e Open G a DADGAD, além das que criares.
• Deteção automática das cordas, com uma marca em cada corda afinada. Um só rasgueado lê todas as cordas e mostra qual deves afinar primeiro.
• Afina pelo tato: o telemóvel pulsa com o batimento entre a corda e a nota de referência, abranda à medida que se aproximam e para quando coincidem. Assim, podes afinar sem olhar.
• Guitarras, baixos, violino, violoncelo e bandolim em 3D, com iluminação de estúdio e indicação da cravelha que deves rodar.
• Capotraste, referência A4 ajustável e nomes de notas em solfejo e sargam.

APRENDE A TOCAR
• 526 aulas em 11 cursos: guitarra, ukulele, baixo, violino, violoncelo, bandolim, banjo, canto, perceção musical, teoria musical e ritmo. Inclui cancioneiros para ukulele, bandolim, violino, violoncelo e baixo.
• O Timbre ouve cada rasgueado: o acorde certo, o momento certo e a corda que não soou. Avalia cada nota enquanto tocas, a altura ao cent e o tempo ao milissegundo.
• «Mostre-me» demonstra cada acorde novo numa guitarra 3D, colocando os dedos pela ordem certa. A pista de notas para tocares em conjunto abranda para ti e volta a acelerar à medida que melhoras.

TOCA MÚSICAS
• Mais de 140 músicas com arranjos completos, incluindo clássicos de Jingle Bells a Amazing Grace e 50 Originals escritos para o Timbre em estilos atuais.
• Toca com a banda nos auscultadores enquanto a letra se ilumina.
• As tuas músicas: cola ou importa uma cifra, transpõe-na, percorre-a ao ritmo da música e ouve o original no Apple Music ao lado.

CONTINUA A PRATICAR
• Estrelas, XP, missões diárias, sequências e conquistas.
• Game Center: liga semanal de Na mosca, classificações de músicas e desafios entre amigos.
• Apple Watch: um metrónomo que sentes no pulso e a prática de hoje num relance.
• Widgets no ecrã principal e no ecrã bloqueado, uma atividade em direto e atalhos da Siri.
• Metrónomo com acentos, subdivisões e treino de velocidade; nota pedal, treino de afinação e biblioteca de acordes e escalas.
• Perceção musical: direção da altura das notas, intervalos e tipos de acordes, além de um curso de 40 aulas.

COMEÇA GRATUITAMENTE
A afinação padrão de cada instrumento é grátis. Guitarra, baixo, ukulele, violino e violoncelo são grátis em todas as afinações. A primeira unidade de cada curso e uma seleção de músicas também são grátis. O Timbre Pro desbloqueia todas as aulas, músicas, afinações e ferramentas de prática. Com as notificações ativadas, o Timbre avisa-te dois dias antes do fim de um período experimental gratuito.

Privacidade desde a conceção: o áudio é analisado no teu iPhone, nunca é gravado nem carregado. Sem conta nem anúncios.

As assinaturas renovam-se automaticamente, a menos que as canceles pelo menos 24 horas antes do fim do período. Podes geri-las ou cancelá-las a qualquer momento em Definições → Conta Apple → Assinaturas.

Free tuner, no ads, no account. Then lessons that listen as you play.

Timbre is a precise tuner and a music teacher in one app. Tune any of 60 instruments in seconds, then play real lessons that listen to you and tell you exactly how you did.

TUNE ANYTHING, FREE
• Every instrument's standard tuning is free, from guitar, ukulele and violin to mandolin, banjo, oud and erhu
• A chromatic and strobe tuner with cent-level precision
• 132 tunings, from drop D and open G to DADGAD, plus your own
• Auto string detection, with a check-off as each string locks in
• Strum to tune: one strum reads every string at once and shows which one to tune first
• Tune by feel: the phone pulses with the beat between your string and its note, slower as they meet and still at the lock, so you can tune without looking
• Studio-lit 3D guitars, basses, violin, cello and mandolin, with the peg to turn shown on the headstock
• Capo, adjustable A4 reference, solfège and sargam note names

LEARN BY PLAYING
• 526 lessons in 11 courses: guitar, ukulele, bass, violin, cello, mandolin, banjo, voice, ear training, music theory and rhythm, plus songbooks for ukulele, mandolin, violin, cello and bass
• Timbre hears every strum: the right chord, on time, and which string didn't ring
• Every note judged as you play it, its pitch to the cent and its timing to the millisecond
• "Show me" plays each new chord on a 3D guitar, the fingers landing in order
• A play-along note highway that slows down for you, then speeds back up as you improve

Бесплатный тюнер. Без рекламы и аккаунта. А затем — уроки, которые слушают вашу игру.

Timbre объединяет точный тюнер и учителя музыки. Настраивайте 60 инструментов и узнавайте, как именно вы сыграли.

НАСТРАИВАЙТЕ БЕСПЛАТНО
• Стандартный строй каждого инструмента бесплатен: гитара, укулеле, скрипка, мандолина, банджо, уд, эрху и другие.
• Хроматический и стробоскопический тюнер с точностью до цента. 132 строя, от Drop D и Open G до DADGAD, плюс собственные.
• Автоопределение струн с отметкой каждой настроенной. Один удар по струнам считывает их все и показывает, какую настроить первой.
• Настройка на ощупь: телефон пульсирует в ритме биений между струной и целевой нотой, замедляется при сближении и замирает при совпадении. Можно не смотреть на экран.
• 3D-гитары, басы, скрипка, виолончель и мандолина со студийным светом и подсказкой, какой колок повернуть.
• Каподастр, регулируемый эталон A4, названия нот сольфеджио и саргам.

УЧИТЕСЬ ИГРАЯ
• 526 уроков в 11 курсах: гитара, укулеле, бас, скрипка, виолончель, мандолина, банджо, вокал, слух, теория музыки и ритм. Плюс песенники для укулеле, мандолины, скрипки, виолончели и баса.
• Timbre слышит каждый удар: верный ли аккорд, вовремя ли он сыгран и какая струна не прозвучала. Каждая нота оценивается по высоте до цента и по времени до миллисекунды.
• «Покажите» играет новый аккорд на 3D-гитаре, ставя пальцы по порядку. Дорожка нот замедляется под вас и ускоряется по мере роста навыка.

ИГРАЙТЕ ПЕСНИ
• Более 140 песен в полных аранжировках: классика от Jingle Bells до Amazing Grace и 50 Originals, написанных для Timbre в современных стилях.
• Играйте с группой в наушниках, пока подсвечиваются слова.
• Ваши песни: вставляйте или импортируйте аккордовые схемы, транспонируйте, прокручивайте в темпе и слушайте рядом оригинал в Apple Music.

ПРОДОЛЖАЙТЕ
• Звёзды, XP, ежедневные задания, серии дней и значки.
• Game Center: еженедельная лига «В яблочко», таблицы лидеров песен и вызовы друзьям.
• Apple Watch: метроном, ощутимый на запястье, и обзор сегодняшней практики.
• Виджеты экрана «Домой» и блокировки, Live Activity и команды Siri.
• Метроном с акцентами, делениями и тренировкой скорости; бурдон, тренажёр чистоты интонации, библиотека аккордов и гамм.
• Слух: направление высоты, интервалы и виды аккордов, а также курс из 40 уроков.

НАЧНИТЕ БЕСПЛАТНО
Стандартный строй любого инструмента бесплатен. Гитара, бас, укулеле, скрипка и виолончель бесплатны во всех строях. Первый раздел каждого курса и подборка песен тоже бесплатны. Timbre Pro открывает все уроки, песни, строи и инструменты практики. Если уведомления включены, Timbre напоминает за два дня до окончания бесплатного пробного периода.

Конфиденциальность по замыслу: звук анализируется на вашем iPhone, никогда не записывается и не загружается. Без аккаунта и рекламы.

Подписка продлевается автоматически, если не отменить её минимум за 24 часа до конца периода. Управление и отмена в любое время: Настройки → Аккаунт Apple → Подписки.
Условия: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Конфиденциальность: <privacy policy URL>
